# VERIFIED PAPERS

## Tier 1 — Direct evidence that the instrument fails

### 1. Can These Views Be One Scene? Evaluating Multiview 3D Consistency when 3D Foundation Models Hallucinate
- arXiv: **2605.18754** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18754
- Submitted 18 May 2026 (v1). Comment: "Project Page at [URL]" (no venue listed)
- Authors: Soumava Paul, Prakhar Kaushik, Alan Yuille — **CCVL, Johns Hopkins University**

**This is the most load-bearing paper for your question.** Verbatim from the abstract:

&gt; "Our analysis shows that VGGT, MASt3R, DUSt3R, and Fast3R can hallucinate dense geometry and cross-view support for unrelated scenes, repeated images, and random noise."

From the body:
&gt; "Modern reconstruction backbones, including VGGT, DUSt3R, MASt3R, and Fast3R, can produce dense 3D structure and spurious cross-view support for inputs that do not correspond to any coherent 3D scene, including unrelated scene mixtures, identical images, and random noise."
&gt; "The failure originates in the backbone: once unsupported geometry is produced, residual aggregation can only partially correct the score."

Key framing for error attribution — classical vs learned failure visibility:
&gt; "Classical multiview geometry verifies reconstruction through explicit evidence... Such pipelines can be slow and can fail under difficult imaging conditions, **but their failures are visible.**" vs. learned backbones: "Their failure behavior is less transparent."
&gt; COLMAP-based metrics "inherit the usual limitations of SfM/MVS, **but their failure modes are measurable rather than hidden.**"

Numbers: SysCON3D controlled benchmark (single outlier views, cross-scene mixtures, repeated images, patched noise, full Gaussian noise); best neural variant MASt3R-W-IMQ is **up to 3× more robust** than MEt3R; COLMAP-based failure-aware metrics achieve **up to 4× higher correlation with human judgments** than MEt3R on Mip-NeRF360 and DL3DV NVS outputs. The appendix has a dedicated section **L.4 "COLMAP failures"**. Explicitly covers diffusion-generated views (Stable Virtual Camera, ViewCrafter, NVS-Solver, MVGenMaster, Difix3D+, GenFusion).

### 2. ORBIT++: Benchmarking SfM in the Wild with 360° Video
- arXiv: **2608.22039** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22039
- Submitted 22 Aug 2026. Comment: **"A revision was Accepted at CVPR 2026"**
- Authors: Sara Sabour, Linyi Jin, Richard Tucker, Amir Hertz, Marcus Brubaker, Saurabh Saxena, Junhwa Hur, Andrea Tagliasacchi, Deqing Sun, David J. Fleet, Richard Szeliski, Noah Snavely — **Google DeepMind / University of Toronto**

This is on *real* video, not generated, but it establishes the base failure rate of the instruments you listed:

&gt; "**Every method completely fails to estimate camera poses on at least 36% of clips.**"
&gt; "Much of the prior work uses COLMAP as a source of truth, while in reality, we observe that **COLMAP fails on many real-world videos.**"

Crucial asymmetry for your measurement design:
&gt; "Some SfM methods, such as MegaSaM and feedforward approaches like VGGT, **always output a camera estimate (no matter how inaccurate).** Other methods, such as COLMAP, sometimes drop a few frames, or can at times completely fail on a clip and produce no output whatsoever."

Their failure definition: a clip counts as completely failed when the method produces no camera estimate **or** ATE/RPE exceeds a threshold. Also: "We noticed that fully feedforward methods such as VGGT-Long and MonST3R are more prone to error in the presence of large camera rotations" and "training-based methods (MegaSAM and VGGtLong) are more susceptible to this failure mode."

### 3. How Far are AI-generated Videos from Simulating the 3D Visual World: A Learned 3D Evaluation Approach (L3DE)
- arXiv: **2406.19568** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19568
- Submitted 27 Jun 2024 (v1), last revised 5 Oct 2025 (v2). Comment: **ICCV 2025**
- Authors: Chirui Chang, Jiahui Liu, Zhengzhe Liu, Xiaoyang Lyu, Yi-Hua Huang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi (HKU / Kuaishou)

**This paper abandoned 3D reconstruction as a measurement instrument on generated video precisely because it is unreliable.** From the abstract:

&gt; "**Instead of relying on 3D reconstruction, which is prone to failure with in-the-wild videos**, L3DE employs a 3D convolutional network, trained on monocular 3D cues of motion, depth, and appearance."

Body:
&gt; "even state-of-the-art reconstruction methods struggle with in-the-wild videos due to challenges such as **unreliable pose estimation** and the absence of multi-view cues, **making large-scale evaluation based on reconstruction impractical.**"
&gt; "**pose estimation often fails on in-the-wild videos, meaning that only a subset of videos — those where camera parameters can be reliably estimated — can be reconstructed for validation.** Within this subset, we use reconstruction to precisely verify L3DE's predicted scores and detected regions. Beyond this subset, human perception provides a more flexible and perceptually grounded evaluation of 3D visual coherence, as it is not constrained by camera estimation failures."

Their workaround is a selection protocol worth noting: for the 15-scene twin-video correlation study they ensured "each scene yields **at least one video that successfully undergoes COLMAP and reconstruction**" — i.e. they conditioned the study on reconstruction success.

---

## Tier 2 — Papers that use the instrument AND calibrate it (your validation templates)

### 4. GeCo: Evaluating Geometric Consistency for Video Generation via Motion and Structure
- arXiv: **2512.22274** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22274
- Submitted 25 Dec 2025 (v1), last revised 19 Aug 2026 (**v5**). No venue comment.
- Authors: Leslie Gu, Junhwa Hur, Charles Herrmann, Fangneng Zhan, Todd Zickler, Deqing Sun, Hanspeter Pfister (Harvard / Google)

**The best example of explicit noise-floor calibration — this is the error-decomposition evidence you asked for (e).** Numbers:

&gt; "Evaluating the components directly, the underlying estimators incur **0.757/1.155 flow EPE (px), 0.056/0.061 depth AbsRel, and 0.513/0.748° pose angular error** on Easy/Hard."
&gt; "The predicted fused score (~0.007 / 0.011) establishes a practical **synthetic noise floor**."
&gt; On DL3DV real video: "yielding a predicted fused score of **0.0223**."
&gt; "**Crucially, the noise floor on both synthetic and real data is an order of magnitude below generated-video scores**" — generated videos land at **0.1–0.3**.
&gt; "This confirms that **elevated scores reflect genuine model-induced geometric failures rather than underlying estimator noise.**"

Plus a controlled noise-injection stress test: "even at σ_flow = 20 px — over 26×/17× the prediction EPE on Easy/Hard — the fused score remains below the generated-video range." Validation datasets WarpBench (TPS warps) and OccluBench isolate deformation vs occlusion. Also flags the degenerate-gaming risk: high consistency scores can be partly achieved by near-static generations.

### 5. WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
- arXiv: **2604.21686** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21686
- Submitted 23 Apr 2026 (v1), revised 5 Aug 2026 (v2). No venue comment.
- Authors: Xiaojie Xu, Zhengyuan Lin, Kang He, Yukang Feng, Xiaofeng Mao, Yuanyang Yin, Yongtao Ge, Kaipeng Zhang (Shanda / corresponding emails @shanda.com)

**This paper ran a head-to-head instrument bake-off on generated video and rejected pose estimators in favor of optical flow.** They compared SEA-RAFT flow against ViPE (bundle-adjusting SLAM) and Depth Anything 3 (feed-forward) on 30 clips per domain:

&gt; "Median per-frame velocity noise is **0.08 on Real and 0.07 on Stylized for flow, 0.28 and 0.27 for SLAM, 0.63 and 0.62 for the feed-forward estimator.** Flow's worst clip reaches 0.3; the feed-forward estimator sits near **eight times** flow's median everywhere, and **SLAM sits near 3.5 times it but exceeds it by two to three orders of magnitude on roughly one clip in eight, peaking at 1119, whenever tracking is lost.**"

Failure taxonomy on generated frames:
&gt; "SLAM fails in two forms: **on a painterly render its feature tracking gives way** and the recovered velocity is a flat trace punctuated by spikes, while elsewhere it keeps tracking but its per-frame noise explodes... **It follows the command only where bundle adjustment fully succeeds.**"
&gt; "The feed-forward stream fails more uniformly and for a different reason: **at this sampling its per-frame pose error dominates the true per-frame motion**, so the differenced velocity is jitter about zero."

And the foundational circularity statement:
&gt; "Answering them from camera poses fails: both SLAM and [feed-forward] **assume a rigid scene, exactly what a failing generative model cannot produce.**"

Also uses DROID-SLAM for reprojection error / translation / rotation error, and reports that visual quality and world consistency are largely uncorrelated.

### 6. Measuring 3D Spatial Geometric Consistency in Dynamic Video Generation (SGC)
- arXiv: **2603.19048** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19048
- Submitted 19 Mar 2026 (v1), last revised 5 Jul 2026 (v2). Comment: **"Accepted at ECCV 2026"**
- Authors: Weijia Dou, Wenzhao Zheng, Weiliang Chen, Yu Zheng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu (Tsinghua)

**The clearest limitations statement of the domain gap (your item d), plus a backbone-swap validation (item e).** Verbatim:

&gt; "The pipeline relies on off-the-shelf foundational estimators (e.g. VGGT, Video Depth Anything)... **Deploying models trained on physically grounded scenes to evaluate artifact-heavy generative videos introduces risks of domain shift and correspondence failures** (e.g. from extreme motion blur or morphing)."
&gt; "While our empirical analysis demonstrates strong relative rank stability across different geometric backbones (**ρ ≥ 0.860**), **SGC currently lacks an absolute error calibration mechanism to entirely disentangle inherent estimator noise from generative geometric corruption during catastrophic scene breakdowns.**"
&gt; "developing **estimator-agnostic absolute error bounds** will be crucial next steps"

Their validation: "A potential concern regarding SGC is its reliance on foundational estimators like VGGT, which are primarily trained on static scenes... we conducted a robustness analysis **replacing VGGT with state-of-the-art dynamic-scene estimators (Any4D and Page4D), alongside an ablation entirely removing the VGGT global pose component**" → Spearman ρ ≥ 0.860. Plus causal-style perturbation injection into nuScenes (non-rigid sinusoidal warping, perspective squeeze, spatial depth warp).

Also states plainly: **"Traditional Structure from Motion (SfM) pipelines (e.g., COLMAP) often fail in reconstructing 3D scenes from generative videos."** And a nice instrument-failure aside: "NuScenes is excluded because Any4D fails on this outdoor dataset."

---

## Tier 3 — Papers that treat estimator failure as the metric, or as a discard rule

### 7. View-Consistent Diffusion Representations for 3D-Consistent Video Generation (ViCoDR)
- arXiv: **2511.18991** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18991
- Submitted 24 Nov 2025. No venue comment.
- Authors: Duolikun Danier, Ge Gao, Steven McDonagh, Changjian Li, Hakan Bilen, Oisin Mac Aodha (**University of Edinburgh**)

**The cleanest published protocol for handling SfM failure on generated video.** Verbatim:

&gt; "**Since SfM can fail on low-quality videos, or videos with insufficient camera baselines (which are rare), we apply a penalty value for RotErr and TransErr to penalize failed reconstructions and additionally report the reconstruction success rate (Succ %) of each method.**"
&gt; "the penalty value for a metric was set to the **99th percentile of all scores obtained by all models** for that metric on that test set."
&gt; Penalty values: **RotErr 3.3 (RE10K) / 4.3 (DL3DV); TransErr 8.0 (RE10K) / 10.0 (DL3DV)**; for the second table, RotErr 4.4 and TransErr 13.8.
&gt; "**Results are reported only on successfully reconstructed videos common to all methods.**"

Reported success rates on generated video — note these are the numbers you want:
- CameraCtrl: **Succ 86.3%** → +ViCoDR: **92.3%** (RotErr 0.795→0.605, TransErr 2.313→1.883, MEt3R 0.066→0.059, RPE 0.385→0.334)
- MotionCtrl: **Succ 89.1%** → +ViCoDR: **96.4%** (FVD 780→559)

So roughly **1 in 8 generated videos could not be reconstructed at all** by their SfM even for a leading camera-control model. Limitation acknowledged: "reliance on external geometry estimation models, **failure of which can lead to inaccurate outputs.**"

### 8. CameraCtrl II: Dynamic Scene Exploration via Camera-controlled Video Diffusion Models
- arXiv: **2503.10592** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10592
- Submitted 13 Mar 2025. Comment: "Project page: [URL]". Published at **ICCV 2025** (per CVF open access).
- Authors: Hao He, Ceyuan Yang, Shanchuan Lin, Yinghao Xu, Meng Wei, Liangke Gui, Qi Zhao, Gordon Wetzstein (CUHK / ByteDance / Stanford)

**Here the SfM failure rate IS the geometric consistency metric.** Verbatim:

&gt; "We apply the VGGSfM on the generated videos, and **calculate the successful ratio of VGGSfM to estimate camera parameters. It indicates the quality of 3D geometry consistency of a generated scene.**"

Example reported value: the Multilayer Injection ablation row reads motion strength 247.23 / TransErr 0.1865 / RotErr 1.78 / **geometric consistency 85.00** — i.e. VGGSfM converged on 85% of generated clips. This is simultaneously (a) evidence that ~15% of generated videos break SfM, and (b) a design that deliberately conflates "generator is bad" with "instrument failed" — the exact error-attribution confound in your item (e). They also use VGGSfM for training-data curation, so the same instrument sits on both sides.

### 9. Quantitative Video World Model Evaluation for Geometric-Consistency (PDI-Bench)
- arXiv: **2605.15185** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15185
- Submitted 14 May 2026. Comment: "12 pages, 5 figures. Project page: [pdi-bench.github.io]"
- Authors: Jiaxin Wu, Yihao Pi, Yinling Zhang, Yuheng Li, Xueyan Zou

Uses SAM 2 + MegaSaM + CoTracker3 to lift generated video to 3D. Their acknowledged limitation is exactly your concern:

&gt; "its accuracy relies on off-the-shelf perception tools; **in degraded videos where 3D uplifting fails, the framework must fall back to 2D proxies, reducing depth-aware precision.**"
&gt; "when **SAM 2, CoTracker3, or MegaSAM fail in low-texture or low-parallax regimes**, the system must fall back to 2D proxies and reconstruction-aware weighting, reducing the depth sensitivity of the final score."

Sample finding: "Sora exhibits catastrophic failure here (PDI=2.13), driven by massive scale distortion (ε_s=4.87)." Calibrated against 15 real-world GT videos vs 168 synthetic videos. Note: the openly-published peer review of this paper (Pith) records that a referee demanded evidence that MegaSaM lifting is accurate enough on generated video, and **the authors conceded that explicit validation on generated content was absent from that version** — I could not independently verify that review exchange, so treat it as unverified.

### 10. GeoT2V-Bench: Benchmarking 3D Consistency in Text-to-Video Models via 3D Reconstruction
- arXiv: **2606.24829** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24829
- Submitted 23 Jun 2026. Comment: "36 pages, 17 figures, 18 tables" (no venue)
- Authors: Chenrui Fan, Paolo Favaro (**University of Bern**)

VGGT-style pose/intrinsics → DeformableGS → MedianGS static proxy. **3,840 completed reconstructions** from 12 open-weight model configs × 80 GeCo-Eval static prompts × 4 seeds. Note the word "completed" — implying incomplete ones existed. Key finding for measurement reliability:

&gt; "we find that **visible motion, static rendering error, flow agreement, and flexible-vs-static behavior often disagree.**"

Hence they refuse a single scalar and report a five-quantity profile, and they filter clips "that lack sufficient active acquisition evidence" via trajectory descriptors. The metric-disagreement result is itself evidence that no single reconstruction-derived number is trustworthy. (The HTML full text was not available — abstract verified from the abs page.)

### 11. Reference-Free Assessment of Physical Consistency in World Model-based Video Generation
- arXiv: **2606.22363** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22363
- Submitted 21 Jun 2026. Comment: **"Accepted to the 2nd 3D-LLM/VLA Workshop, CVPR 2026"**
- Authors: Yun Oh, Sukmin Yun (Hanyang University)

Uses DROID-SLAM + SEA-RAFT, motivated by WorldScore, to build an **anomaly score that filters out physically implausible generated rollouts** before a VLM reward model sees them. Result: filtered videos improve VLA task success rate by **over 8%**. Key measurement finding: "3D and photometric consistency show distinctive gaps between real and generated distributions, while median subjective quality remains comparable — **generated videos contain significantly more outliers** on the consistency measures." This is the useful inverse framing: SLAM-derived consistency is a good *outlier detector* on generated video even where it is a poor absolute measurement.

### 12. WorldScore: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for World Generation
- arXiv: **2504.00983** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.00983
- Submitted 1 Apr 2025 (v1), last revised 29 Nov 2025 (v2). Comment: **"ICCV 2025. Project website: [URL]. The first two authors contributed equally"**
- Authors: Haoyi Duan, Hong-Xing Yu, Sirui Chen, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu (**Stanford**)

Camera controllability = **DROID-SLAM** poses + scale-invariant rotation/translation error; 3D consistency = dense depth + reprojection error. 3,000 test examples, 8 camera movements, ~19-20 models. Methodologically relevant: because the metric has no natural upper bound, they use "a sequence of fixed cameras as a baseline, penalizing generations that fail to exhibit any camera movement." # Published papers reporting FAILURES / DEGRADATION of 3D &amp; geometry foundation models

All papers below were verified by pulling the arXiv abs-page metadata (`citation_title`, `citation_date`, `citation_author`, the Comments field, submission/revision dates) and, where numbers are quoted, by fetching the paper's own HTML/PDF and extracting the result tables. Numbers in quotes are lifted from the papers' own tables.

## TIER 1 — Dedicated benchmark / evaluation papers (VERIFIED, with numbers)

### 1. E3D-Bench: A Benchmark for End-to-End 3D Geometric Foundation Models
- arXiv: **2506.01933** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01933
- Published 2025-06-02 (v1), last revised 2025-07-10 (v3)
- First author: **Wenyan Cong** (UT Austin VITA Group); co-authors incl. Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone (NVIDIA), Zhangyang Wang, Zhiwen Fan
- Comment field: "Project Page: https://e3dbench.github.io" (no venue stated; OpenReview record exists: `IsuH97hLke`)
- 16 GFMs × 11 datasets × 5 tasks

**Failure evidence (Table 4, multi-view relative pose, exact values I extracted from the paper's HTML):** the air-ground ULTRRA split is a near-total collapse. RPE-rot / RPE-trans on ULTRRA vs. the same models on indoor Bonn/Sintel/Rel10k:
| Model | ULTRRA RPE-trans | ULTRRA RPE-rot | (Bonn/Sintel/Rel10k RPE-rot) |
|---|---|---|---|
| DUSt3R/LSM | **70.350** | **70.390** | 1.657 |
| MASt3R | **71.519** | **78.036** | 1.305 |
| VGGT | **63.451** | **77.281** | 0.580 |
| MonST3R | **70.388** | **77.325** | 0.830 |
| CUT3R | **55.135** | **54.395** | 0.500 |
| Fast3R | **51.149** | **54.150** | 2.017 |
| Spann3R | **40.503** | **38.366** | 1.297 |

i.e. rotation error goes from ~0.5–2° indoors to **54–78°** on air-ground pairs — roughly a 100× degradation, and VGGT (the best model elsewhere) is among the *worst* on ULTRRA.

Other verified failures: on KITTI Odometry (street driving) Spann3R ATE = **15.848** and Fast3R ATE = **22.109** vs. VGGT 0.955 — order-of-magnitude blowups. Fast3R RPE-rot on long sequences (ScanNet/ADT/TUM-Dyn) = **23.739°**, MonST3R = 12.817°, vs. VGGT 1.535°. MonST3R on CO3Dv2 RPE-rot = **23.458°**. Paper's own verdict text: "GFMs generalize well on in-domain and out-of-domain data regimes, but **degrade sharply under extreme distribution shifts**"; "in the metric-scale setting, **MASt3R and CUT3R fail to meet the strict threshold** (&lt;3% error)"; "GFMs that need global alignment incur significantly longer inference times and are **more susceptible to out-of-memory (OOM) issues**."

### 2. SpatialBench: Is Your Spatial Foundation Model an All-Round Player?
- arXiv: **2605.27367** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27367
- Published 2026-05-26 (v1), revised 2026-05-29 (v2)
- First author: **Haosong Peng**; co-authors incl. Fangzhou Hong, Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu (NTU S-Lab), Dingwen Zhang, Wenchao Xu
- Comment field: "Project Page: https://ropedia.github.io/SpatialBench/" (no venue stated)
- 19 datasets, 546 scenes, 5 domains, **41 models / 6 paradigms**, 4 input-density regimes

**Failure evidence (quoted from the paper):** "**Egocentric and wrist-view domains remain the dominant OOD failure modes**, exposing a field-level gap that cannot be addressed by scaling existing training mixtures alone." And: "the cross-method average remains relatively strong on indoor datasets, while **performance drops sharply on ego-view and especially wrist-view sequences**. This failure is **not caused by a single weak model**: the OOD curve averages over the full evaluated method pool, indicating a **field-level limitation**." Domain-level OOD severity is reported as mean **AUC@30 grouped by evaluation domain** (Fig. 9). Their remedy quantifies the gap size: retraining DA3-Giant on in-domain ego/wrist data (DA-Next) gives depth AbsRel **0.095 → 0.050 (−47%)** on sparse inputs and **0.086 → 0.035 (−59%)** on medium, with **AUC@30 +3.1% and +5.5%** — i.e. that much accuracy was being lost purely to domain shift. Also verified: "bounded-memory models unlock long-horizon scalability **at the cost of geometry estimation accuracy**."

### 3. An Evaluation of DUSt3R/MASt3R/VGGT 3D Reconstruction on Photogrammetric Aerial Blocks
- arXiv: **2507.14798** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.14798
- Published 2025-07-20 (v1), last revised 2025-10-24 (v2)
- First author: **Xinyi Wu**; Steven Landgraf &amp; Markus Ulrich (**Karlsruhe Institute of Technology**), Rongjun Qin (**The Ohio State University**) — affiliations confirmed via alphaXiv structured metadata
- Comment field: "23 pages, 7 figures, this manuscript has been submitted to **Geo-spatial Information Science** for consideration" (now published, doi:10.1080/10095020.2025.2597491)
- This is the single best (c) out-of-domain paper. I extracted the actual tables from the v2 PDF.

**Failure evidence (exact table values):**
- **Pose collapse at normal aerial overlap (Table 6).** Camera-center distance error at 70% overlap: **DUSt3R 47.21 m, MASt3R 50.57 m**, VGGT 1.534 m — vs. COLMAP-HR 0.152 m. Angle error at 70% overlap: **DUSt3R 141.3°, MASt3R 58.08°, VGGT 92.07°**, COLMAP-HR 17.62°. At 10% overlap: DUSt3R 111.5 m / 48.11°, MASt3R 109.4 m / 47.37°.
- **Inlier rate ≈ 0 (Table 7, "success rate with inliers in parentheses", inlier = center dist &lt;1 m AND angle &lt;10°).** At 70% overlap: **DUSt3R 100 (0), MASt3R 100 (0), VGGT 100 (10)**; at 55%: DUSt3R 100 (0), MASt3R 100 (0), VGGT 100 (6); at 40/25/10%: **all three models 100 (0)** — i.e. every pose is "reconstructed" but **0% of them are inliers**, while COLMAP-HR reaches 64/53/35/22/11.
- **Poses off by hundreds of metres.** Paper text: "DUSt3R and MASt3R face challenges, with the global alignment process resulting in **approximately 20% of the estimated poses deviating significantly** from the ground truth, with **some discrepancies exceeding several hundred meters**."
- **Hard scalability ceilings.** "The **38-image subset is the largest that DUSt3R and MASt3R can handle** on our hardware"; **191 images is the max for VGGT** on their device. At 191 images (Table 8) **VGGT point-cloud accuracy = 2.936 m / 5.991 m / 2.988 m** across the three datasets vs. COLMAP-HR **0.123 m / 0.876 m** — a **~7–24× accuracy gap** — with VGGT camera-center distance **10.41 m and 42.22 m** and angle **101.6° / 81.97°**, and **no valid inliers found** for VGGT in those settings.
- Where the models win: 2-image wide-baseline, where "COLMAP often fails or produces low-quality models... accuracy of up to 2.3 m", vs. the foundation models at "up to 0.4 m" and "+10%"–"+50%" completeness.

### 4. On Geometric Understanding and Learned Priors in Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction Models
- arXiv: **2512.11508** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11508
- Published 2025-12-12 (v1), last revised 2026-03-17 (v2)
- First author: **Jelena Bratulić**; Sudhanshu Mittal, Thomas Brox (**Univ. of Freiburg**), Christian Rupprecht (**Oxford VGG**)
- Comment field: **None** (no venue listed)
- Models: **VGGT, DUSt3R, Depth Anything 3**. This is the best (b)/hallucination-mechanism paper.

**Failure evidence (quoted from paper):** the hallucination result is explicit — under patch occlusion, "**approximately 50% of heads are retained, indicating that the model does not ignore occluded regions but recovers correspondences through some inpainting behavior**" (they attribute it to DINOv2's iBOT masked loss). Causal fragility: "disrupting the high-performing attention heads in the middle layers degrades the Sampson distance error **to such a large degree that it can be regarded as a complete failure**... in VGGT, **disabling only four heads in a single layer already leads to substantial degradation**." Lighting: "**VGGT's failure rate (Sampson error larger than 10 pixels) increases under extreme lighting changes and shadow variations**... particularly for **top-view lighting, which removes shadows**, and for **neon and rainbow lighting**"; crucially the failure is *asymmetric* — "it is specifically the case where **only one view is intervened** that it fails (Sampson error over 10 pixels) more often." Symmetry/repetition: "VGGT outperforms baselines, even when only shadows disambiguate symmetric objects, but **fails on completely ambiguous scenes without shadows**." Note for DUSt3R specifically: "For DUSt3R, this requires post-processing steps that **can result in invalid camera poses, which we consider a failure case**." Failure threshold is defined as invalid output or Sampson error &gt;10 px; exact per-condition rates are in Figs. 18–19 (bar charts, not tabulated).

- arXiv: **2512.04012** — https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.04012

- Comment field: "Project page: https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/RobustVGGT/" (community pages list it as CVPR 2026; the arXiv comment itself does not state a venue — treat the venue as unverified)

Their fix is flat by comparison (RobustVGGT-F ATE **0.2641 → 0.2664**). Two important negative controls: **appearance descriptors don't fix it** — DINOv3+VGGT (0.3068 → 0.3833) and DINOv2+VGGT are numerically *identical to raw VGGT*, i.e. "appearance descriptors alone cannot perform geometric filtering." Framing quote: "feed-forward 3D reconstruction models **lack these explicit mechanisms** [geometric verification, outlier rejection], leading to **degraded performance under in-the-wild conditions**." | 失效模式 | 证据 |
|---|---|

**因果脆弱** | 同上：**只禁用单层里 4 个 head 就导致完全失败** |
**加视角反而变差** | Diversity-aware View Partitioning（**ECCV 2026**）：**盲目增加视角数会降低性能**，冗余视角产生高相似 token 稀释几何信号 |
**Ego/wrist 视角** | SpatialBench（41 个模型）：**egocentric 和 wrist-view 是主要 OOD 失效模式**，"**field-level limitation**，不是单个模型弱" |

# 文献新颖性核查报告：视频世界模型评测 (2026-05 ~ 2026-09)

所有论文均用 `curl -s https://arxiv.org/abs/&lt;id&gt;` 逐一验证（标题/日期/作者/Comments/Subjects 均引自该页面）。**注意：我最初的 Comments 正则有误、一度漏报了几个 venue，已用修正后的正则重新核对全部条目**——下面的 venue 信息是修正后的结果。

## 核心结论（先说要点）

1. **你猜测的"几何/3D 一致性能预测下游控制成功"这一命题，目前唯一真正做了该相关性计算的论文给出了否定结果。** RoboPhys-3D (2608.28718) 对 50 个指标逐一算 Pearson，筛选门槛 `min{r(m,AP), r(m,DE), r(m,VLM-2)} &gt; 0.70`，**通过的 8 个指标是 JEPA Similarity、Semantics Consistency、Subject Adherence、Instruction Following、Average Recall、Physical Commonsense、nDTW、以及 FVD——四个 3D geometry consistency 子维度全部未通过**。论文原文还写道 3D 几何一致性"与其余三个层级几乎不相关"。这对你的选题既是机会也是威胁，必须正面处理。
2. **"metric X 比 FVD/PSNR/LPIPS 更能预测控制成功"是 2026 年的汇聚性主题，不是某一篇的独家论点**，但胜出的代理变量是**动作条件类**（Δ-LPIPS、逆动力学一致、SE(3) action-following）和**执行/结果类**（可执行性、progress、policy-ranking 相关性），**不是几何类**。
3. **空白点**：没有任何论文用 VGGT/pointmap 分数对**真实闭环策略成功率**报告 ρ。GEM-4D 把几何质量和机器人成功率放在相邻表格里却从不做相关（全文无 Pearson/Spearman/correlat）。

## 2. "metric X 预测控制成功优于 FVD" 全景

**最强可引用证据：**

- **RigidBench** [2608.15555](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15555) (2026-08-16, Swarnim Jain &amp; Shangzhe Wu；Comments: 30 pages, Code, Dataset)。摘要原文：跨模型均值 **"higher SSIM accompanies larger 3D trajectory error (r = 0.89)"**——全场最干净的反相关数字。且全量微调 Wan 2.2 使 3D 轨迹误差降约 20% 而 SSIM 几乎不变。注意靶标是 3D 轨迹误差，不是机器人成功率。
- **CI-MSE** [2606.29898](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29898) (2026-06-29, Haoxu Huang, 清华/上海期智；无 Comments)。摘要明载 **Spearman −0.87 vs 原始 MSE −0.61**。最直接的"我的指标在预测 rollout 成功上打败标准指标"，但基线是 validation MSE 而非 FVD。
- **MiraBench** [2605.29360](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29360) (2026-05-28, Tianzhuo Yang, Yaodong Yang 末位→北大；无 Comments)。16000+ 人类判断、12 个模型配置，摘要直言"视觉保真度是 action fidelity 的劣质代理"。无 r 值。
- **Admissibility** [2607.07196](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07196) (2026-07-08, Christian Oefinger, TUM；**Comments: "Accepted at RSS 2026 Workshop on Robot World Models"**)。摘要点名 **"FVD reward visual realism, but ignore whether the world responds correctly to the policy's actions"**，并报告 L0/L1 出现排序反转。
- **GigaWorld-1 / WMBench** [2607.02642](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02642) (2026-07-02, GigaWorld Team；Comments: Project page)。**我已从 HTML 正文取到确切数字**：组级 Visual Fidelity ρ=0.78 &gt; Geometry ρ=0.71 &gt; Semantics ρ=0.59；单指标 Subject Consistency ρ=0.88、Perspectivity ρ=0.86、Instruction Following ρ=0.84；**Background Consistency ρ=−0.45、Photometric Consistency ρ=−0.42**（静止视频可刷分）。结论"evaluator 质量由长时程、动作忠实的 rollout 一致性主导，而非短时视觉真实性"。
- **Objective Is the Bottleneck** [2608.12959](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.12959) (2026-08-13, Joyjeet Singh)：潜空间距离仅 r=0.426 跟踪真距离，而 ridge probe 能以 R²=0.9922 恢复位置——"准确的指标恰是错的指标"。
- **立场论文** [2606.15032](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15032) (2026-06-13 / v2 06-28, Yang Yu；无 Comments，cs.LG)：L0–L7 阶梯，把 FID/FVD/PSNR 依赖诊断为 model-based RL **objective-mismatch** 的重演。**值得注意：它明确把 3D 一致性连同 object permanence/depth 一起划到 L3，建议作为辅助诊断而非主分数**——与你的论点直接对立，必须在 related work 里回应。
- 其他：**Dream.exe** [2606.04811](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04811)（2026-06-03/v2, Rui Zhao, NUS Show Lab；101 任务，"视觉质量是可执行性的劣质预测器"）、**WorldSimProbe** [2608.09298](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09298)（2026-08-10, Peterson Co；Observable Simulator Contract，5 套件 18000+ 实例）、**WorldEcho/WorldSync** [2608.24885](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24885)（2026-08-25, Sixiang Chen；SE(3) 轨迹对齐探测 off-expert 动作跟随）、**GAUGE** [2608.05948](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05948)（2026-08-06, Shuai Wang；动捕标定的物理保真）、**KineBench** [2607.19876](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.19876)（2026-07-22, Zeyu Liu；**Comments: "Accept to ECCV2026"**；IDM-free，级联视觉基础模型直接抽 6D 末端位姿 + SPARC/Maruyama 可操作度）、**RoboTrustBench** [2606.01600](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01600)（**Comments: "EMNLP 2026 Findings"**）。

## 4. 用 3D 重建模型做生成视频的评测器

- **RoboPhys-3D** [2608.28718](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28718) (2026-08-28, Tianyi Wang, **UT Austin**（已在 HTML 确认邮箱 utexas.edu）+ Purdue + Futurewei；Comments: "66 pages, 12 figures, 55 tables"，无 venue)。**最相关的一篇**：用 **VGGT、VGGT-Ω、4DGS、4C4D 四套重建器**同管线处理生成与 GT 视频，从而分离"重建误差"与"生成误差"；RoboTwin 2.0、50 任务、5000 episode、145,000 视频。RoboPhyscore vs 人类 **r=0.9761 / ρ=0.8962**。**但如前述，几何维度全部未过 0.70 的任务成功相关门槛。**
- **PDI-Bench** [2605.15185](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15185) (2026-05-14, Jiaxin Wu；Comments: 12 pages, Project page)。SAM2 + CoTracker3 + MegaSaM 抬升到 3D，算 scale-depth/3D motion/rigidity 三类投影几何残差。**无任何 Pearson/Spearman，也无策略成功率。**
- **GeoT2V-Bench** [2606.24829](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24829) (2026-06-23, Chenrui Fan &amp; Paolo Favaro)、**Stream4D** [2608.19556](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19556) (2026-08-20, UCLA，StreamVGGT+MoVieS 做 4D-PSNR 奖励)、**MemoBench** [2606.27537](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27537) (v6 2026-07-19, MapAnything 做位姿)、**GeoCon-Bench** [2608.09594](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09594)——均无机器人控制相关性。
- **重建即奖励**一族（可复用为 judge）：**World-R1** [2604.24764](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24764)（**ICML 2026**，Depth Anything 3 提 3DGS + meta-view）、**VideoGPA** [2601.23286](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23286)（**ICML 2026**）、**VGGRPO** [2603.26599](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26599)（**ECCV 2026**）、**SGC** [2603.19048](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19048)（**ECCV 2026**，换掉 VGGT 后 ρ≥0.860 仍稳）、**VIGOR** [2603.16271](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16271)、**GeoFlow** [2605.18365](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18365)、**GeCo** [2512.22274](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22274)（v5 2026-08-19，给出 VGGT 估计器噪声底 0.513°/0.748°——这是"用学习式重建器当裁判"最有力的辩护）。
- ⚠️ **必读的威胁性论文**：[2605.18754](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18754) "Can These Views Be One Scene?"（2026-05-18, Soumava Paul, **JHU CCVL**）——VGGT/MASt3R/DUSt3R/Fast3R 会对无关场景、重复图、随机噪声幻觉出稠密几何与跨视支撑，即**重建式一致性分数会把垃圾判为一致**。它点名 robotics 为受影响领域。任何 pointmap 指标方案都必须回应这一点。
- **GenVid2Robot** [2607.09191](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09191) (2026-07-10, Haohui Huang；Comments: "Preprint")：rigid-geometric consistency 把生成视频转真机轨迹——用几何做执行而非评测。
- **Reference-Free Physical Consistency** [2606.22363](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22363) (2026-06-21, Yun Oh, 汉阳大学 ERICA；**Comments: "Accepted to the 2nd 3D-LLM/VLA Workshop, CVPR 2026"**)：DROID-SLAM + SEA-RAFT，无参考；按此过滤 rollout 使**任务成功率提升 &gt;8%**（因果增益，非相关系数）。摘要明确对标"unavailable ground-truth references (FVD)"。

## 5. 2026-09 最新（列表页扫描所得，两个子代理都未覆盖）

我直接抓取了 arXiv 月度列表页（`/list/cs.RO/2026-09?skip=0&amp;show=2000` 等，共解析 7071 条），补到：

- **IMPLY** [2609.12441](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.12441) (2026-09-11, Aman Mehta；Comments: 7 pages)：**直接打击自一致性指标**——"现用的一致性检查只问模型的多个未来是否彼此一致，而它们都不懂物理"。通过反演仿真器读出每条 rollout 隐含的质量/摩擦，锚定到两次校准推动；自一致性会给"忽略物体、永远预测典型推动"的模型满分，而 anchoring 能揭穿（AUROC 0.70 vs ...）。对你的选题极其相关。
- **VeriPhy** [2609.03153](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03153) (2026-09-02, Wenzhuo Xu)：agentic 物理验证，"视觉流畅不意味物理可靠，单一标量分数无法指出违反了哪条义务、在哪一刻失败"。
- **Identifying Habit, Physics, and Nuisance** [2609.09210](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09210) (2026-09-06, Jinting Hang)：用结构因果模型把示教的多模态性拆成 operator habit / shared physics / observation nuisance。
- **Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control?** [2609.02811](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02811) (2026-09-02, Dharini Raghavan；Comments: 20 pages)：非视觉但形状完全对——replay RMSE vs rollout error 预测闭环性能 **Spearman 0.923 vs 0.774**，选错估计器 5/24 vs 18/24。
- **SA-WAM** [2609.02531](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02531) (2026-09-02, Javier Lopetegui, **Cordelia Schmid** 末位)：RGB+depth 联合预测，明确"分析世界模型预测质量与策略 rollout 成功率之间的相关性"。
- **PhysWeep** [2609.06207](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06207) (2026-09-05)："plausibility 本身就是错的测试"。

## 对你选题的三点提示

1. **RoboPhys-3D 的否定结果 + 立场论文 2606.15032 把 3D 一致性降级为辅助诊断，构成对"几何→控制效用"叙事最直接的双重威胁**。建议的破法：他们用的是 Depth-Anything 深度差/重建内部一致性，而**非**"配对噪声受控下的几何量"——这与你笔记中"配对噪声是成败关键 (0.968 vs 0.286)"的既有发现正好咬合，可作为差异化论点。
2. **2605.18754 的幻觉结论 + GeCo 的噪声底 + SGC 的换估计器稳健性 (ρ≥0.860)**，三篇合起来正好是"pointmap 指标能不能当裁判"的正反论证材料，务必都引。
3. **真正的空白是明确的**：无人用 VGGT/pointmap 分数对真实闭环策略成功率报告秩相关；GEM-4D 把两者并列却不做相关。这是可占的位置。</result>

## 重新表述：WoG 的 `O^c` 是一个退化的信息瓶颈

标准信息瓶颈是两项：

```
min  I(X; Z)  −  β·I(Z; Y)
     ↑压缩项      ↑充分性项
```

而 Stage I 的 loss 是 `act_loss` **一项**（今天验的，`obs_loss` 硬置零）。也就是：

> **WoG 只有充分性项，没有压缩项。** 512 维、有效秩 18、当前帧还被喂两遍。

所以 `O^c` 是"对动作充分"的，但**不是极小充分**。这不是实现瑕疵，是目标函数的定义。

## 关键的一步：该压缩掉的不是"信息量"，而是"学生已知的部分"

普通 IB 的压缩项会**无差别**惩罚所有信息。但这里的浪费是有指向的：

**`z` 本来就看得见 `O_t`。所以 `O^c` 里关于 `O_t` 的信息，对学生是冗余的。**

Stage II 在干的事是：让 `z` 去预测 `z` 自己已经拥有的信息。这就是你测到 1.35:1 的机制。

→ 正确的目标不是"极小充分"，而是**条件极小充分**：

> `O^c` 应该是「给定 `z` 已有信息后，对动作仍然必要」的那部分。
> **与 `z` 的冗余就是纯粹的浪费。**

## 这跟你 doc 12 的提法差一步，而这一步是关键

你 doc 12 写的是"`O^c` 减去**当前帧可解释**的部分"。我说的是"减去 **`z` 可预测**的部分"。

**两者不同**：`z` 是学生的表征，它包含的东西比原始当前帧特征可能更多也可能更少。而决定"对学生是否冗余"的**只能是 `z`**，不是原始像素特征。

这给出一个可证伪的预测：**对 `z` 取残差应该优于对当前帧特征取残差。** 如果实测反过来，这个框架就错了。

## 为什么这不只是修 WoG

这条原则对**所有**"预测未来当辅助目标"的方法都适用：FLARE、DreamVLA、Seer、VPP 全都是把学生对齐到**完整**的教师目标，没有一个先扣掉学生已知的部分。

而查重已经显示：**FLARE 换成信息更少的 average-pooled 目标反而更好（50.9% vs 49.6%）、DreamVLA 单独预测 DINOv2 掉 0.51**。这两个"反常"在这个框架下都不反常了——**目标里的冗余在稀释梯度**。

---

## 问题出在哪

`per_direction_causal` 的度量没有归一化扰动幅度。我在比"抹掉不同方向造成的动作变化"，但**每个方向被抹掉时，`O^c` 本身的变化量不同**（正比于该方向方差）。于是我测的是"输入变化多少"，不是"单位输入变化引起多少输出变化"。

**正确的度量应该是敏感度**：`Δ动作 / Δ输入`，而不是 `Δ动作`。

# WoG 两阶段结构性错配 —— 查重报告

**方法说明**：所有 arXiv 条目均用 `curl https://arxiv.org/abs/&lt;id&gt;` 逐条核实（标题/作者/日期/subjects/Comments/摘要）。venue 取自 abs 页 Comments 字段；无 Comments 则标注"仅预印本"。

**网络限制（影响结论完备性，必须声明）**：
- OpenReview **完全不可达**：代理返回 `X-Squid-Error: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED`（CONNECT 403）。**ICML 2026 的审稿意见/rebuttal 未能检查**。
- `pith.science` / `lacuna.tiptreesystems.com` / `awesomepapers.io` / Semantic Scholar API 全部 000 不可达。这些站点（据搜索快照）托管论文评审，**只有快照、未能核实**。
- arXiv 站内检索**只索引标题+摘要，不索引全文**，因此"谁引用了 WoG"无法穷尽。这是本报告最大的盲区。

## 一、最终判决：**(c) 部分做过，有明确空白**

拆开看，你的"审计发现"由五个可分离的断言组成。**四个已被发表过（有的措辞几乎一致），第五个未找到先例。**

| # | 断言 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 辅助未来瓶颈夹带"当前帧就有"的冗余信息 | ❌ **已发表**，且不止一篇 |
| 2 | 对齐目标应只含"超出当前帧的独有成分" | ❌ **已发表**，措辞几乎相同 |
| 3 | teacher 目标不是按 student 消费方式定义的 → 错配 | ❌ **已发表**（privileged-information 整条线） |
| 4 | 蒸馏搬过去的主要是学生已知信息 | ❌ **已发表**（KD 领域，非 VLA） |
| 5 | **同一瓶颈的不同部分被两个阶段分别使用，且部署只保留后者**（跨阶段因果归因不一致，96% vs 1.35:1） | ✅ **未找到先例** |

## 二、必须正面处理的三篇"撞车"论文

### ⚠️ 头号威胁：Present but Not Remembered（方法论孪生）

- **arXiv**: 2607.03372 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03372
- **时间**: 2026-07-03 · **作者**: Chih-Ting Liao, Xin Cao · **Comments**: 无（仅预印本）· cs.CV

**这篇和你的 exp11 是同一套动作**：layer-resolved 线性 probe + **causal interchange intervention**，把表征分解为「当前帧可解释」与「超出当前帧的独有成分」，测各自的因果部署强度。

原文结论（已核实）：
&gt; "information unique to history beyond the current frame is **nearly absent**, indicating that stored history is largely a **redundant copy of the present**"
&gt; "future memory augmentation should **inject information unique to the past rather than simply more history**"

**你的 docs/09 + docs/12 的逻辑骨架与之完全同构**：分解 → probe → 因果干预 → 「残差才是有用的那部分」→ 「应该只对齐残差」。

**唯一差别**：它做的是**过去/历史**方向、单模型冻结 VLA；你做的是**未来**方向、**跨两个 checkpoint 的两阶段 teacher-student**。这个差别是真实的，但**你必须在论文里显式引用并划界**，否则审稿人会直接判重复。

### ⚠️ 次号威胁：GIFT（同一问题的"设计侧"答案）

- **arXiv**: 2609.04193 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04193
- **时间**: 2026-09-03 · **作者**: Yupeng Zheng 等 14 人（含 Shuicheng Yan, Dongbin Zhao）· **Comments**: 无（仅预印本）· cs.RO

提出 **"action-sufficiency gap"**：
&gt; "their native action and visual-prediction objectives may **omit critical physical and task structure while retaining control-irrelevant visual redundancy**. We call this mismatch between visual richness and control utility the action-sufficiency gap."

**更要命的是它做了 injection / no-injection 消融**——正对应你的"Stage-II 关掉 condition→action 通路"：
&gt; "The **no-injection** formulation is the main design of GIFT because it most directly tests whether structured intermediate supervision alone produces control-oriented intermediate features **without routing auxiliary predictions into the action-generation interface**."
&gt; "Ablation studies further show that the **no-injection variants perform better**."

即：GIFT 已经实证「辅助监督不接进 action head 反而更好」。你的批评"Stage-II 关通路 = 错配"因此**不能当作自明的缺陷来陈述**——已有工作表明这可能是特性而非 bug。

### ⚠️ 三号：Beyond Task Success（最接近的"审计"论文）

- **arXiv**: 2606.01095 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01095
- **时间**: 2026-05-31 · **机构**（已从全文核实）: National Economics University (Vietnam) / Singapore Management University / Phenikaa University · **Comments**: 无 · cs.RO

把 WAM 分成三族，其中 **auxiliary WAM = "use future prediction only as a training objective and discard it at inference time"** —— 正是 WoG/FLARE 那一类的抽象。结论：
&gt; "**auxiliary WAMs compress future information** into a more VLA-like policy, and joint WAMs encode richer but more entangled trajectory-level information"
&gt; "Auxiliary designs are efficient, but they **risk compressing or weakening the future-modeling signal at inference time**."

**缓解因素（已核实）**：其 auxiliary WAM 实例是 **FastWAM / VLA-JEPA，不是 WoG/FLARE**；全文检索 `WoG` = 0 命中、`FLARE` = 0 命中、`two-stage` = 0 命中。用的是 SAE 特征分类（memorized/reactive/predictive），**没有做瓶颈分解，也没有跨阶段对比**。所以是"同一批判方向、不同方法、不同对象"。

## 三、逐题回答

### Q1：有没有人审计过两阶段/teacher-student VLA 的结构性错配？

**有，但没有人审计 WoG/FLARE/DIAL 这一支的两阶段错配。** 已核实清单：

| arXiv | 标题 | 时间 | venue (Comments) |
|---|---|---|---|
| [2606.01095](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01095) | Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA | 2026-05-31 | 无 |
| [2607.03372](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03372) | Present but Not Remembered: Auditing How Frozen VLAs Encode, Deploy, and Steer Visual History | 2026-07-03 | 无 |
| [2603.19233](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19233) | Not All Features Are Created Equal: A Mechanistic Study of VLA Models | 2026-03-19 | **Multimodal Intelligence Workshop @ ICLR** |
| [2605.30117](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30117) | VLA-Trace: Diagnosing VLA Models through Representation and Behavior Tracing | 2026-05-28 (v2 08-30) | 无 |
| [2605.00321](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00321) | Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in VLA | 2026-05-01 (v2 06-10) | **ICML 2026** |
| [2608.04692](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04692) | Suppression Sticks, Locality Is Fragile: A Closed-Loop Target-and-Control **Audit** of Task-Vector Negation in VLA | 2026-08-05 | 无（28页预印本）|
| [2605.07514](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07514) | Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models | 2026-05-08 | Technical Report |
| [2608.24885](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24885) | Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? | 2026-08-25 | 无 |
| [2606.09028](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09028) | ATM: Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for Diagnosing Latent World Models | 2026-06-08 | 无（13页）|

**关键空白已确认**：FLARE、WoG、DIAL、VPP、Seer、GR-1/2 **没有任何一篇被专门做过这类阶段级机制审计**。（`abs:"FLARE" AND cat:cs.RO` 15 条中除原文外全是同名不相关工作。）

**另有两篇"结构平行的方法论文"（非审计，但会被审稿人拿来对比）**：
- [2609.12641](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.12641) **LIT**（2026-09-11）：two-stage，Stage-1 用 terminal SE(3) pose 做条件，Stage-2 换成 latent interface 作为**唯一**视觉通路并监督其重建该 pose。**"Stage-1 的条件在 Stage-2 被替换成对齐目标"这个结构和 WoG 一模一样**，但它是当作正面设计提出的。
- [2602.10098](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10098) **VLA-JEPA**（2026-02-10）：开篇即"current latent-action objectives **often learn the wrong thing**"，主打 leakage-free（未来只作监督目标、绝不作输入）。这是"目标空间选错了"批评的最近邻。

### Q2：KD 领域的「teacher target 被用于两个用途导致错配」

**核心概念存在，但表述是"nuisance/容量/可实现性"，不是"双用途"。** 已核实：

| arXiv | 标题 | 时间 | venue |
|---|---|---|---|
| [2411.07483](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07483) | Quantifying Knowledge Distillation Using **Partial Information Decomposition** | 2024-11-12 (v2 2025-04) | **AISTATS 2025** |
| [2106.05945](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.05945) | Does Knowledge Distillation Really Work? | 2021-06-10 | **NeurIPS 2021** |
| [2405.13078](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.13078) | Exploring Dark Knowledge under Various Teacher Capacities and Addressing **Capacity Mismatch** | 2024-05-21 (v2 2025-06) | 无 |
| [2301.12245](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.12245) | Supervision Complexity and its Role in Knowledge Distillation | 2023-01-28 | **ICLR 2023** |

**2411.07483 (RID) 是你必须引的**——它直接说：
&gt; "the teacher's representations can also encode **nuisance or additional information not relevant to the downstream task**. Distilling such irrelevant information can actually **impede** the performance of a capacity-limited student."

并用 PID 把"task-relevant transferred knowledge"量化为 teacher/student 关于任务的**冗余信息**。这在信息论层面已经覆盖了你的断言 1 和 4。

### Q3：「搬过去的主要是学生已知的信息」这类诊断

**有，且是本报告第二强的撞车点。**

- [2411.07483](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07483)（同上）：PID 分解 transferred vs left-to-distill。
- [2412.13943](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13943) **UniCAM**（2024-12-18，**WACV 2025**）：明确区分 **distilled features vs residual features**，提出 FSS/RS 两个指标量化"学生从老师那里学到了什么、没学到什么"。
- [2607.03372](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03372)：VLA 内直接测出"history 基本是 present 的冗余副本"。

三者合起来，**「对齐搬的是已知信息」这一条在 KD 和 VLA 两侧都已有人报告过**。你的 1.35:1 只是同一现象在新对象上的复现。

### Q4：辅助目标定义的空间 vs 后期被改变的下游通路 → 目标稀释/梯度浪费

**有先例，且不止一个领域。**

- [2606.05718](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05718) **ViCuR**（2026-06-04，25页预印本）：*"answer-side privilege creates a **train-test mismatch**: the teacher's supervision may depend on signals unavailable to the student, encouraging **shortcut imitation**"* → 改用 student **可恢复（recoverable）**的 privilege。**这是你"应该只对齐未来独有成分"的镜像论证。**
- [2606.30626](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30626) **DOPD**（2026-06-29）：命名 **"privilege illusion"** —— *"conflates the transferable capability gap that students are meant to close, and the information asymmetry gap that can only be mimicked but never replicated"*。**这几乎就是你的核心主张的 LLM 版本。**
- [2412.09149](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.09149) **SITT**（2024-12-12，**ICLR 2025**）：teacher 训练时不考虑 student 能否模仿 → 改成 student-informed 联合训练。
- [2505.09546](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09546) **Distilling Realizable Students from Unrealizable Teachers**（2025-05-14，IROS 2025）：teacher 的指导在 student 观测空间中**不可实现**。
- 经典源头（均已核实）：[2007.12173](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.12173) ADVISOR（**NeurIPS 2021**，"imitation gap"）、[2012.15566](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.15566) A2D（**ICML 2021**，"the expert does not know what the trainee cannot see"）、[2208.02225](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.02225) Swamy et al.（2022）。

**这条线是你发现的真正理论归宿，也是最大的原创性威胁。** 注意关键区别（这是你的立足点）：经典 imitation gap 讲的是 teacher 的**动作**不可实现；你讲的是 teacher 的**目标空间是按另一个消费者定义的**。相关但不同——不过这个区别需要你主动论证，不会被默认承认。

### Q5：具体到 WoG

**已核实事实**：
- **venue = ICML 2026**（项目页 https://selen-suyue.github.io/WoGNet/ 明示；GitHub 描述亦为 `[ICML 2026]`；ICML 虚拟会场 poster/61757 存在于搜索快照）
- **机构 = ByteDance Seed + MMLab@HKU**，通讯 Yuxiao Liu / Xihui Liu
- **仓库** = https://github.com/Selen-Suyue/WoG，171 stars / 6 forks，创建 2026-02-26，最后推送 2026-04-28，**README 自称 "unofficial implemention"**

**GitHub issues 共 5 条，全部与你的批评无关**（已逐条读取）：#1 HF 上架、#5 PWC 验证（均为 HF 的 Niels 机器人式邀请）、#3/#4 问 GPU 数与训练时长、#2 问 Stage-1 训练步数与 config 不一致（100k steps vs `epochs:100 / max_steps:null`）。**无任何人质疑两阶段设计。**

**判决**：**未找到任何公开工作分析 WoG 的两阶段设计**（论文、blog、review、issue 均无）。但这个结论受限于 OpenReview 与 Semantic Scholar 不可达，**属"未能证实其不存在"，而非"已证实不存在"**。

**⚠️ 一个必须自查的问题**：WoG 论文的 **Table 8 自己就报了** `WoG w/o cotrain`（去掉 Stage-II 条件监督）性能 ≈ Vanilla VLA（Microwave 95% vs 90%，Fold 30% vs 40%）。也就是说**"全部收益来自 Stage-II 对齐、Stage-I 通路对部署无贡献"这件事，论文自己的消融已经呈现了**，只是没当成问题。你的 docs/07 把它当"反常"是对的，但**不能说这是你首次发现**。

同时 WoG 还做了 `WoG w/o Future Enc. in Stage-II` 消融（Stage-I 保留 encoder、Stage-II 丢弃并改对齐原始特征图）：66.7% vs 标准版 70.9%。**即"改 Stage-II 对齐目标"这个操作面，作者已经探过一格了。**

### Q6：把 bottleneck 分解成「学生可解释 + 不可解释」并分别测因果贡献与方差占比

**最接近的两篇**：
- [2607.03372](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03372)：做了 present / unique-beyond-present 分解 + 因果 interchange。**方法同构，对象不同。**
- [2411.07483](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07483)：PID 做 redundant/unique/synergistic 分解，但是信息论量、无因果干预、非机器人。

**⚠️ 方法论警告**：[2605.09169](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09169) *Prediction Bottlenecks Don't Discover Causal Structure*（2026-05-09，v2 06-14，6页+代码）系统性证明**从瓶颈几何/方差推因果结构会在 size-matched control 下崩塌**。你的 docs/12 已经做了置换检验（很好），但审稿人会用这篇要求你补 **size-matched / dimension-matched control**——即"随机挑一个同维度子空间"的对照，而不只是"打乱配对"。

**结论**：你的具体分解（对同一个 teacher 瓶颈，同时测「对 Stage-I action head 的因果作用占比」与「对 Stage-II 学生表征的搬运占比」，并显示两者指向不同成分）**未找到先例**。

### Q7：2026 年 5–9 月新出现的审计/机制分析类工作

**这条线正在爆发**——扫描 cs.RO 2026-05~09 月度列表共 **5,766 条**，命中大量审计类标题。除上表外还有：[2609.16815](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16815)（Rethinking Visual Embodiment Dependence，2026-09-15，shortcut 干预）、[2606.31382](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.31382)（Revisiting Parameter Redundancy in VLA，**ECCV 2026**）、[2605.28527](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28527)（What Frozen VLAs Already Know About Success，PKU+CAU）、[2608.13474](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13474)（Decoding Task Progress from VLA Representations，Cornell）、[2606.14153](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14153)（Frozen-Backbone Grafting Diagnostic）、[2609.02634](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02634)（Latent Cluster Analysis for VLA）。

**战术含义：窗口正在快速关闭。** 「VLA 机制审计」在 2026 下半年已是拥挤赛道，你那套 probe + 因果干预的工具箱**本身不再有新意**——新意只能来自对象和那一条跨阶段不一致的测量。

## 四、诚实评估：这个发现值多少

**不平庸，但比你想的窄。**

**站得住的部分（唯一的）**：
&gt; Stage-I 的 DiT 对 `O^c` 的因果作用 96% 来自未来成分；Stage-II 的对齐却主要把当前帧成分搬进 `z`（净值比 1.35:1）。**两个阶段在消费同一个瓶颈的不同部分，而部署模型只保留后者。**

这是一个**跨阶段的、双向的归因不一致**测量。上述所有论文都只测单侧：GIFT 测"注不注入"的性能差；Present-but-Not-Remembered 测单模型内的 present/unique 分解；PID/RID 测信息论冗余；imitation-gap 那条线测动作可实现性。**没有人拿着同一个 teacher 瓶颈，分别量化它对「Stage-I 的消费者」和「Stage-II 的学生」的作用，并显示两者错位。**

**站不住的部分（必须删掉或大幅弱化）**：

1. **"bottleneck 只有充分性压力、没有压缩项"——事实上不准确。** WoG 的 Q-Former 用 **16 个 query** 就是架构级压缩，且论文消融显示 16 优于 64（64 会 overfit 到无关视觉细节）。准确表述应是"有架构瓶颈但无信息论压缩惩罚项"。**照现在的写法会被一句话打掉。**

2. **"Stage-II 关掉 condition→action 通路 = 错配"——已被 GIFT 实证反驳。** GIFT 的 no-injection 变体**性能更好**。你不能把它当作自明缺陷。

3. **"同一瓶颈被用在两个用途上"这个 framing 本身不新。** DOPD 的 "privilege illusion"、ViCuR 的 recoverable-privilege、SITT 的 student-informed teacher 都是同一洞察的不同外衣。

4. **"对齐搬的主要是学生已知信息"不新。** 2411.07483 + 2412.13943 + 2607.03372 三面夹击。

5. **docs/07 的"Table 8 反常"不是你的发现**——是 WoG 论文自己报的数。

---

## 五、要让这个发现站得住，必须补什么

按投入产出排序：

1. **【必做，否决性】重训 Stage-II 验证"只对齐未来独有成分"**。你的 docs/12 自己写了"未验证改了会更好"。当前所有证据都是**观测性的**；而 GIFT 已经证明"不注入更好"，Present-but-Not-Remembered 已经提出"只注入独有成分"的建议。**你若只交测量不交干预，就是把别人已经说过的建议重复一遍。** 这一步是全部价值的所在。

2. **【必做】加 size-matched / dimension-matched 对照**（应对 2605.09169）。现有置换检验标定的是"配对"零假设，不是"同维随机子空间"零假设。「当前帧成分」与「未来独有成分」两个子空间维度是否相等？若不等，1.35:1 可能是维度效应。

3. **【必做】显式引用并划界这五篇**：2607.03372（方法孪生）、2609.04193（no-injection 已证更好）、2606.01095（auxiliary WAM 已被批"compress future"）、2411.07483（PID 冗余已量化）、2606.30626 / 2606.05718（privilege illusion / recoverable privilege）。每篇一句话说清"它做了 X，我做的是 Y"。**不引 = 送人头。**

# LeJEPA / SIGReg / LeWorldModel — 2026 Follow-Up Cluster

**Method**: All metadata below was extracted by `curl`-ing `https://arxiv.org/abs/&lt;id&gt;` and parsing `citation_*` meta tags + the Comments/Subjects table cells. Full texts were fetched from `https://arxiv.org/html/&lt;id&gt;v{1,2,3}` and grepped. Everything marked **VERIFIED** was directly curled by me. No fetch failed for any assigned ID — all 14 assigned abs pages and all 14 HTML full texts resolved (HTML at the version noted).

**Note on `citation_date` vs `citation_online_date`**: arXiv's `citation_date` = v1 submission date; `citation_online_date` = announcement/latest-version date. Where they differ materially I flag it (e.g., anchor: v1 2026-03-13, online 2026-06-03 = the v3 announcement).

## 1. ANCHOR — LeWorldModel (LeWM)

**arXiv 2603.19312** · https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19312 · **VERIFIED**
- **Title**: *LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels*
- **citation_date** 2026/03/13 · **citation_online_date** 2026/06/03 · versions v1 2026-03-13, v2 2026-03-24, v3 2026-06-03
- **Authors**: Lucas Maes\*, Quentin Le Lidec\*, Damien Scieur, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero
- **Institutions** (from HTML): Mila &amp; Université de Montréal; New York University; Samsung SAIL; Brown University
- **Comments raw**: `&lt;&lt;NO COMMENTS FIELD&gt;&gt;` (the abs page has no Comments row)
- **Subjects**: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
- **One-liner**: First JEPA trained stably end-to-end from raw pixels with only two loss terms (next-embedding prediction + SIGReg), ~15M params, 1 GPU, plans up to 48× faster than foundation-model WMs.
- **Hyperparameter claim**: reduces tunable loss hyperparameters "from six to one" vs. the only existing end-to-end alternative (PLDM).

**Verbatim limitations (§"Limitations &amp; Future Work")**:
&gt; "Several limitations point to future directions. Planning remains restricted to short horizons, motivating hierarchical world modeling for long-horizon reasoning. Our method also relies on offline datasets with sufficient coverage; in particular, low data diversity weakens SIGReg in simple, low-dimensional environments where matching a high-dimensional Gaussian prior is harder. Pre-training on large, diverse video datasets could provide stronger priors and reduce domain-specific data needs. Finally, dependence on action labels could be alleviated by inverse dynamics modeling."

**The paper's own admission of the SIGReg weakness (§4.2, verbatim)** — this is the seed that four follow-ups exploit:
&gt; "Interestingly, LeWM performs worse on the simplest environment, Two-Room. A possible explanation is that the low diversity and low intrinsic dimensionality of this dataset make it difficult for the encoder to match the isotropic Gaussian prior enforced by SIGReg in a high-dimensional latent space, which may lead to a less structured latent representation. This highlights a potential limitation of the SIGReg regularization in very low-complexity environments."

And (§4.3, verbatim) — the planning/representation dissociation that later papers formalize:
&gt; "Although LeWM underperforms PLDM in downstream planning on this environment, it matches or outperforms PLDM across all probing metrics… This suggests that the learned latent space captures the underlying physical state equally well and that the planning gap is not due to a less informative representation but rather to other factors such as the dynamics model or the planning procedure itself."

Other anchor facts (VERIFIED): λ (SIGReg weight) is the only effective hyperparameter; success &gt;80% for λ∈[0.01,0.2], peak ≈0.09, degrades sharply at λ=0.5. Reference numbers later reused as baselines: Two-Room 84.33±4.23, Reacher 82.67±4.42, PushT 84.67±6.53, OGB-Cube 67.33±5.01 (six seeds, as cited by Sub-JEPA/QQWorld).

## 2. THE CRITIQUES (highest priority)

### 2.1 Independent reproduction — does it reproduce? *Partly, and the failure is protocol-level.*

**arXiv 2608.10145** · https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10145 · **VERIFIED** (HTML v1)
- **Title**: *The Evaluation Protocol Determines the Result: An Independent Reproduction of LeWorldModel on TwoRoom*
- **citation_date** 2026/08/10 · **citation_online_date** 2026/08/10 · v1 only
- **Author / institution**: Joyjeet Singh — **Independent researcher** (ORCID 0009-0005-1512-7439)
- **Comments raw**: `Independent reproduction of arXiv:2603.19312 - this https URL`
- **Subjects**: Machine Learning (cs.LG)
- **Relevance**: The single most damaging paper in the cluster. It does NOT claim LeWM is wrong; it claims the *published number is protocol-contingent* and the *released configs alone do not train*.

**Headline quantitative disagreement (VERIFIED, verbatim)**:
&gt; "the evaluation protocol described in the paper does not reproduce the paper's reported result on the paper's own released weights, and the released repository's evaluation defaults do. We do not know which the authors used, and we do not assume"

&gt; "The three claims we set out to test (§2) resolve as follows. The representation claim reproduces directly and easily. The planning claim reproduces under one of the two evaluation protocols the released material publishes — 94.0% at the repository's goal offset against a reported ~87%, and 84.0% for the authors' own weights under that same protocol — once four undocumented conventions are corrected; under the protocol the paper's appendix describes, the authors' own weights reach 14.0%. The training claim does not reproduce from the released configuration files alone, and does reproduce once those conventions are supplied — which we take to be a documentation gap rather than a defect in the method."

&gt; "On fifty identical episodes, changing nothing but how the goal is constructed moves that checkpoint from 84.0% to 8.0%." (abstract) — with in-text: "The result is 84.0% against 8.0%: 39 episodes are solved under the first and missed under the second… \chi^2 = 34.2, p &lt; 10^-8. No property of the model changed between those two numbers."

**Four undocumented conventions (verbatim)**: "dense action gathering across a frameskip block, a programmatically-set action-encoder width, ImageNet pixel normalisation, and action z-scoring. A reproducer following the released configurations alone obtains a model whose predictor cannot converge."

**Twelvefold preprocessing sensitivity (verbatim)**: "Encoding frames under raw [0,1] pixel values, their checkpoint predicts the next latent state with an error 5.1 times a frozen-world baseline — five times worse than assuming nothing moves. Under ImageNet normalisation the same weights score 0.410. A twelvefold difference makes the convention effectively mandatory".

**Dataset-level objection to the paper's own appendix protocol (verbatim)**: "The dataset contains 10,000 episodes of mean length 92.1 and maximum length exactly 101. An episode can supply a goal 100 frames after its start only if it runs longer than 100 frames, so the eligible set is precisely the 6,056 episodes that reached the length cap. That cap is a timeout… Of the 6,056 eligible episodes, only 91 — 1.5% — were solved by the policy that generated them. Evaluating at an offset of 100 therefore asks the planner to reach the point at which a failing policy ran out of time." Also: "the maximum sampling span across all 6,056 eligible episodes is zero… the description is implementable at the offset the configuration uses, and not at the offset the appendix states."

**The generalizing negative result (verbatim)**: "A world model that predicts one step ahead seven times more accurately than another was not detectably better at short-horizon planning and was decisively worse at long-horizon planning — and this holds for the authors' released checkpoint as well as for ours. Selecting a world model by held-out prediction error is not a reliable way to select a world model for planning".

**Its own self-declared limitations (verbatim, §7)** — important for calibrating how much weight to give it:
&gt; "A single seed throughout. Every training run, every planning evaluation and every probe in this paper uses one seed. We make no estimate of seed variance, and none of our differences should be read as robust to reinitialisation… the differences we report between checkpoints (94.0% against 84.0% at goal offset 25, p = 0.0625; 94.0% against 78.0%, p = 0.0574) are already not established at our sample size of fifty episodes."
&gt; "Ten epochs, not one hundred. We follow the paper's appendix, which states ten epochs; the released repository configuration specifies max_epochs: 100… a reader with our resources cannot test the repository's own configuration."
&gt; "Our results characterise our checkpoints, not the method… A same-room planning advantage that was pre-registered, distance-matched, verified reachable by an oracle, and significant at p = 3.4×10⁻⁸ on one checkpoint fell to +12.7 points under a change of action scaling and to −6.4 points on a different checkpoint."
&gt; "The mechanism of the long-horizon reversal is untested… Three checkpoints cannot separate prediction accuracy from context length."
&gt; "Scope. All results concern the TwoRoom diagnostic environment. We make no claim about the original's embodied or zero-shot results, about its other environments, or about the method's behaviour at scales other than the 18.03M-parameter configuration studied here."
&gt; "a batch normalisation layer inflated our reported validation loss by up to a factor of 300, concealing a training loss that was flat throughout." (abstract)

### 2.2 Direct challenge to the isotropic-Gaussian premise

**arXiv 2608.17542** · https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17542 · **VERIFIED** (HTML v1)
- **Title**: *No Gaussian Required: Contrastive Inverse Dynamics for JEPA World Models*
- **citation_date** 2026/08/18 · **citation_online_date** 2026/08/18 · v1 only
- **Authors / institution**: Jack Boylan, Chris Hokamp — **Quantexa**
- **Comments raw**: `17 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL`
- **Subjects**: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
- **One-liner**: Replaces SIGReg with Action-NCE (inverse-dynamics contrastive head, discarded after training) — a *distribution-free* anti-collapse signal; test-time model is byte-identical to LeWM.

**The core philosophical critique (verbatim, abstract + Conclusion)**:
&gt; "LeWorldModel (LeWM) prevents collapse with SIGReg, a regularizer that forces the latent distribution to match an isotropic Gaussian: the representation is stabilized by prescribing what it must look like, independently of the environment it models. We argue that the anti-collapse pressure can instead come from the transition data itself."
&gt; "A world model's representation has to be protected from collapse, but nothing about the problem says that protection must take the form of a prescribed latent distribution."

**Quantitative disagreement (VERIFIED, Table 3 — 3 seeds, 200 eval episodes/seed; 50 on Scene)**:

| Task | SIGReg (LeWM) | AC-MTM | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| TwoRoom | 85.5±0.4 | **90.7±0.6** | +5.2 |
| Reacher | 68.8±0.2 | 68.3±3.1 | −0.5 |
| PushT | **93.2±0.2** | 86.7±1.5 | **−6.5** |
| OGB-Cube | 66.2±0.2 | **78.8±1.7** | +12.6 |
| OGB-Scene | 58.0±2.0 | **80.0±2.0** | **+22.0** |

&gt; "On OGBench Visual Scene, where a single arm controls a drawer, window, buttons, and a movable cube, SIGReg drops to a three-seed mean of 58.0%… while AC-MTM remains at 80.0%, with gains of 24, 20, and 22 points across the three training seeds. A single 50-episode random-policy run gives a 52% baseline estimate."

**Where it concedes SIGReg is better (verbatim, §5 "What Action-NCE does not solve")** — critical for a balanced read:
&gt; "The contrastive loss still emphasizes state that separates actions. It does not unconditionally preserve every task-relevant variable, unlike SIGReg's global variance pressure. PushT requires accurate block pose and orientation even when the same commanded action has little visible effect before contact. This is a plausible reason both inverse variants remain below SIGReg."

**Self-declared limitations (verbatim, §7)**:
&gt; "AC-MTM provides no unconditional geometric guarantee. It requires variation in the action candidates and useful visual evidence about action effects; unobserved actuators, stochastic dynamics, no-op-heavy datasets, or many duplicate actions can weaken the contrastive task. We evaluate normalized continuous controls only. Discrete, hybrid, structured, and very high-dimensional action spaces may require different scores…"
&gt; "PushT shows the flip side of the dynamics-native pressure: a variable that actions barely move can be underweighted even when it matters for the task"
&gt; "under the official 750-step fixed-goal protocol, neither method solves the tasks at this model scale (Appendix B)."
&gt; "the Scene gain may also reflect lower one-step forward error." (i.e., it explicitly hedges its own headline result)

Also notable: SIGReg *wins decisively* on the surprise/violation-of-expectation diagnostic (PushT action-counterfactual 151.7±4.7× vs AC-MTM 9.6±0.3×; state-discontinuity 1246.0±34.1× vs 40.0±1.4×) — though the paper cautions ratios are within-model normalized and "should be compared within a model, not across models".

### 2.3 "Isotropic Gaussian in ambient space is too strong a bias"

**arXiv 2605.09241** · https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09241 · **VERIFIED** (HTML v1)
- **Title**: *Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models*
- **citation_date** 2026/05/10 · **citation_online_date** 2026/05/10 · v1 only
- **Authors / institutions**: Kai Zhao, Dongliang Nie, Yuchen Lin, Zhehan Luo, Yixiao Gu, Deng-Ping Fan, Dan Zeng — **Shanghai University**; University of Manchester; Nankai University
- **Comments raw**: `this https URL` (bare code link)
- **Subjects**: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
- **Note**: the abs-page abstract is mangled — "this http URL" tokens replaced sentence-ending words, and the method name renders as "ame" (a broken LaTeX macro). The HTML full text is clean.

**The critique (verbatim)**:
&gt; "latent representations typically lie on low-dimensional manifolds embedded within the high-dimensional ambient space… and enforcing an isotropic Gaussian prior directly in this ambient space introduces an overly strong bias that mismatches the intrinsic geometry"
&gt; "Our key insight is that the isotropic Gaussian prior enforced by LeWM operates in the full high-dimensional latent space, which introduces an excessive bias when the underlying task dynamics reside on a low-dimensional manifold."

**Mechanistic evidence (verbatim, §4.2.2)**:
&gt; "This direct correspondence strongly supports our hypothesis: when task-relevant features lie on a low-dimensional manifold, the full-space Gaussian prior in LeWM forces the latent space into unnecessarily high rank, imposing a bias that hinders task-aligned representation learning. Subspace-wise regularization relaxes this bias and allows the latent geometry to contract toward the task's intrinsic dimensionality—the greater this contraction, the larger the planning gain."

**Quantitative disagreement (VERIFIED, Table 1 — 6 seeds)**: LeWM 84.33±4.23 / 82.67±4.42 / 84.67±6.53 / 67.33±5.01 → Sub-JEPA **95.00±2.76 / 84.00±4.00 / 89.00±5.33 / 76.33±5.99** (Two-Room / Reacher / PushT / OGB-Cube). Largest gain (+10.7 pts) is exactly on Two-Room — the environment LeWM itself flagged.
&gt; "the improvement is most prominent on Two-Room. LeWM is known to struggle here because enforcing isotropic Gaussianity over the entire high-dimensional embedding introduces an overly restrictive bias for this low-intrinsic-dimension task."

**Its own bias-variance caveat (verbatim, §4.3.2)**:
&gt; "performance is stable across a broad mid-range of (K,d_s) configurations, but degrades sharply when subspaces become too narrow (small d_s), where the normality signal grows unreliable. This reveals a bias-variance tradeoff in subspace design: larger K relaxes the global prior but requires sufficient d_s to maintain regularization stability."
&gt; "Increasing K relaxes the global Gaussian prior and enables more expressive latent structure, while excessively small subspaces may weaken the effectiveness of the regularization signal."

**No dedicated Limitations section** — the paper has none (COULD NOT CONFIRM any beyond the ablation caveats above).

### 2.4 Pitfalls of hierarchical planning

**arXiv 2607.12547** · https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12547 · **VERIFIED** (HTML v2)

## PART A — Classic baselines (all VERIFIED via `curl https://arxiv.org/abs/&lt;id&gt;`)

### A1. TD-MPC2 — **2310.16828** — VERIFIED
- URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.16828 (latest v2)
- Title: *TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control*
- `citation_date` **2023/10/25**; `citation_online_date` **2024/03/21**
- Authors: Nicklas Hansen; Hao Su; Xiaolong Wang (UC San Diego — from tdmpc2.com; affiliations not in arXiv meta)
- **Comments raw:** `ICLR 2024. Explore videos, models, data, code, and more at this https URL`
- Subjects: `Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Robotics (cs.RO)`
- Journal ref: NONE

**Does TD-MPC2 ablate latent dimension? NO. This is the single most load-bearing finding of this survey.** Fetched `https://arxiv.org/html/2310.16828` (393KB) and grepped exhaustively. Findings:

1. Latent dim is only ever varied *as a bundled consequence of overall model scaling*, never independently. Table 9 (VERBATIM):
   &gt; "Table 9: Model configurations. … **Latent state dim** is the dimensionality of the latent representation 𝐳 … **1M / 5M\* / 19M / 48M / 317M** … Encoder dim 256 / 256 / 1024 / 1792 / 4096; MLP dim 384 / 512 / 1024 / 1792 / 4096; **Latent state dim 128 / 512 / 768 / 768 / 1376**; # encoder layers 2/2/3/4/5; # Q-functions 2/5/5/5/8"
   
   Note 48M and 317M share latent dim 768 with 19M and 1376 respectively — dimension is *not* a controlled variable.

2. **The decisive quote (VERBATIM, Appendix H):**
   &gt; "We scale the model size by varying dimensions of fully-connected layers, the latent state dimension 𝐳, the number of encoder layers, and the number of Q-functions. **We make no other modifications to the architecture nor hyperparameters across model sizes.** … **We did not experiment with other model configurations.**"

3. The main ablation set (Figure 9) covers everything *except* dimensionality (VERBATIM):
   &gt; "**We ablate most of our design choices for TD-MPC 2, including choice of actor, various normalization techniques, regression objective, and number of Q-functions.**"

4. Default single-task config: `Latent state dim 512`, `SimNorm dim (V) 8`, `Encoder dim 256`, `MLP dim 512`. SimNorm partitions z into L simplices of dim V=8 — a *sparsity/geometry* choice explicitly motivated, not a dimensionality study: "it naturally biases the representation towards sparsity without enforcing hard constraints."

5. Open problems listed by the authors are about **discrete action spaces**, **finetuning**, and **reward-free pretraining** — dimensionality is never named as an open problem:
   &gt; "extending TD-MPC 2 to discrete action spaces remains an open problem"
   &gt; "finetuning world models to new tasks is very much an open research problem"

- URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04104

- **Comments raw:** `Website: this https URL`
- Subjects: `Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Machine Learning (stat.ML)`
- **Journal ref field: NONE. DOI field: NONE.** Only the arXiv-issued DataCite DOI `10.48550/arXiv.2301.04104` is present.

**On the Nature question — important caveat.** The arXiv record has **no Journal-ref and no publisher DOI**; I grepped the full abs page and the v2 HTML and found zero "Nature" self-references. The Nature version exists but under a **different title**: *"Mastering diverse control tasks through world models"*, Nature 640, 647–653 (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-08744-2, published online 2 April 2025 — this is UNVERIFIED-by-curl (my direct fetch of nature.com returned no parseable metadata, likely paywall/bot-block) and comes from web search results. The arXiv preprint was **never updated to point at the Nature paper**, so citing "DreamerV3 = arXiv 2301.04104" and "DreamerV3 = Nature 2025" requires knowing they are the same work under two titles. **The arXiv v2 HTML is already the Nature-formatted manuscript** (it uses numeric superscript citations and Nature section structure: "Results", "Ablations", "Scaling properties"), which corroborates the identification.

**Latent-dimension ablation in DreamerV3: NO.** Scaling is by total parameters only — VERBATIM: "we train 6 model sizes ranging from **12M to 400M parameters** … Figure 6 shows robust learning with fixed hyperparameters across the compared model sizes and replay ratios." The ablations are over robustness *techniques*: "we ablate the robustness techniques and learning signals on a diverse set of 14 tasks … all robustness techniques contribute to performance, most notably the KL objective of the world model, followed by return normalization and symexp twohot regression."

**Prediction-target finding worth quoting (VERBATIM, Fig 6b caption):**
&gt; "The performance of Dreamer predominantly rests on the **unsupervised reconstruction loss** of its world model, unlike most prior algorithms that rely predominantly on reward and value prediction gradients."

This is the direct antipode of TD-MPC2's decoder-free reward/value-only target — a clean, citable target-choice disagreement between the two leading MBRL lines.
