Conceptually the strongest "the fixed null is the problem" paper.

## Bottom line for your research gap
The literature has thoroughly established that the null branch is bad (undertrained per 2503.20240, off-manifold per 2406.08070/2503.18137, semantically vacuous per 2603.10780) and has replaced it with: random conditions (ICG), degraded conditions (CDG), weaker models (autoguidance), base-model priors (2503.20240), perturbed attention (PAG/SEG/ACG), score-space label averages (MG), and learned reward-optimized embeddings (ReNeg). **Nobody has published the embedding-space mean-of-conditioning null, and nobody has ablated null-token initialization.** Both are genuinely open, and CDG's "Negative Reframing" related-work section is where a reviewer will look for prior art.</result>

## 改动 ④（uncondition 初始化）的判决

**坏消息：整个"null branch 有问题"这件事已经被做透了**，而且形成了一个有名字的子领域——CDG（CVPR 2026）把它叫做 **"Negative Reframing"**：

| 批评角度 | 论文 |
|---|---|
**undertrained**（5-20% dropout 导致无条件分支训练不足） | `Unconditional Priors Matter!` **WACV 2026** |
**off-manifold** | CFG++ / TCFG (**CVPR 2025**) |
**semantically vacuous** | CDG (**CVPR 2026**) |
**static null 是瓶颈** | A-CFG |

替代方案也全占了：随机条件（ICG, **ICLR 2025**）、退化条件（CDG）、弱模型（autoguidance, **NeurIPS 2024**）、base model 先验、扰动注意力（PAG/SEG/ACG）、score 空间平均（MG）、reward 优化的嵌入（ReNeg, **CVPR 2025**）。

**好消息：恰恰"嵌入空间的均值 null"和"null token 初始化的消融"没人做过。** 调研在 arXiv API + Semantic Scholar + 15 个查询变体后都没找到。

**但我要给自己泼一盆冷水**——调研自己指出了一个理论问题：

> 均值嵌入是**条件流形的质心，不是流形上的样本**，所以它可能**比 ICG 的随机条件更 OOD**，可能表现得像一个 mode-collapsed 条件。

**MG（`Diffusion Models without CFG`）在 score 空间做平均才是数学上正确的版本**——`∇log p = −(1/Nσ)·Σᵢ ε_θ(x,t,cᵢ)`。

→ **所以改动 ④ 不该按我原来说的做。** 如果要做，应该是：`v_base = (1/N)·Σᵢ DiT(x_t, t, z, O^c_i)`，在 **score 空间**平均，而不是在嵌入空间取均值。这只是 PFD 的一个实现细节，不是独立贡献。

## 一个对你更重要的发现

`ACG`（**ICRA 2026**，KAIST）—— 它是 flow-based VLA 上的 CFG 工作，原文说：

> "in VLA models, applying CFG by replacing the language condition often shows **unstable behaviors**, since action distributions can vary significantly with even subtle differences in language instructions"

**他们因此彻底放弃了 null 分支**，改用注意力扰动。

这直接关系到 PFD 在 WoG 上能不能成立——**PFD 需要 `v_base`，而 ACG 说在 VLA 上 null 分支本身就不稳定。**

不过注意区别：ACG 说的是**替换语言条件**，而 PFD 在 WoG 上是**替换 `O^c`**（视觉未来条件）。这两个不是同一件事，但 ACG 的 `White Noise Guidance` baseline 给了一个现成的替代方案。

# Prior-Art Search: Self-Conditioning (Analog Bits / RIN style) in Robotics / VLA Action Generation

## Method &amp; coverage

I built a corpus of **3,383 unique arXiv papers** from cs.RO / cs.LG / cs.CV (queries: `diffusion policy`, `flow matching`, `action diffusion`, `vision-language-action`, `visuomotor`, `manipulation + diffusion`, `trajectory/motion prediction + diffusion`, `e2e autonomous driving + diffusion`, `action expert`, `imitation learning + diffusion`, `offline RL + diffusion`, `world model + action + diffusion`), then **downloaded and grepped the full HTML text** of every one for `self.conditio*`. Coverage: 3,383/3,383 fetched, ~44 pages had no HTML rendering (pre-2023 PDF-only). I also ran exact-phrase arXiv abstract/title/all-field searches and the arXiv API. Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google HTML, paperswithcode were all **network-blocked** from this machine; arXiv API + arXiv search + HF papers search + WebSearch were the working channels.

Only **17 + 5 + 1 = 23 papers out of 3,383** mention "self-condition" at all. That itself is the headline result.

---

## VERIFIED — true or near-true hits

### 1. TrajFlow — the closest *verbatim* prior art (motion forecasting, not manipulation)
- **Title:** TrajFlow: Multi-modal Motion Prediction via Flow Matching
- **arXiv:** 2506.08541 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08541 (v1 2025-06-10, v2 2025-07-05)
- **Authors:** Qi Yan, Brian Zhang, Yutong Zhang, Daniel Yang, Joshua White, Di Chen, Jiachao Liu, Langechuan Liu, Binnan Zhuang, Shaoshuai Shi, Renjie Liao
- **Institutions:** UBC / Vector Institute / Waterloo / Georgia Tech / CMU (+ industry co-authors)
- **Comments field:** `IROS 2025`
- **Code:** public — https://github.com/DSL-Lab/TrajFlow, page https://traj-flow.github.io/
- **Mechanism (Alg. 1 in appendix, verified verbatim):** flow-matching trajectory decoder `F_θ(Y^t, C, t)`. With probability 0.5, the model first runs a forward pass to get `Y̌¹`, then **rebuilds the interpolant as `Y^t ← t·Y̌¹ + (1−t)·Y⁰`** and runs a second forward pass. Both passes are supervised. They explicitly cite Analog Bits [47] and state the difference: "we use the initial denoised result to **modify the noise-corrupted input** rather than **concatenating to augment the input**."
- **Is the conditioning encoder re-run with the noisy action? NO.** The scene context encoder `C` is computed once and explicitly cached ("The context encoder's forward pass can also use a caching mechanism to accelerate computation"). Only the trajectory-space decoder is re-run. Also **self-conditioning is training-only** — "there is no need to implement the self-conditioning step in the sampling process." So it is an anti-overfitting regularizer, not an inference-time iterative refinement.

### 2. INDI / "Act with Intent" — the closest hit in real robot manipulation VLA
- **Title:** Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
- **arXiv:** 2608.23478 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23478 (submitted 2026-08-24)
- **Authors:** Sangoh Lee, Sangwoo Mo, Wook-Shin Han — **POSTECH (GSAI / IME)**
- **Comments field:** `Project page: this https URL` (no venue stated) — page https://leesangoh.github.io/indi-project-page/; no code repo found
- **Mechanism:** Adds visual/textual "grounding rows" `Z_t^{V,λ}, Z_t^{R,λ}` plus clean intent queries to the flow-matching action-expert sequence of **GR00T-N1.7 and π0.5**. Training: a **no-gradient forward pass** predicts clean decoder-space grounding states `Z̄`, which are then **detached (sg) and re-noised at the sampled flow time**: `Z_t^{V,λ} = (1−λ)ε_V + λ·sg(Z̄_t^V)` — i.e. **literal double forward pass + stop-gradient self-conditioning, applied to condition/grounding tokens rather than to the action itself**. At inference, "the visual and textual states are **carried across denoising steps using the same self-conditioning convention**."
- **Is the perception encoder re-run with the noisy action? Partially — this is the key nuance.** The *frozen VLM backbone* is NOT re-run (its prefix KV is cached). But **decoder-space visual/textual grounding representations ARE re-estimated and carried forward across denoising steps inside the action decoder, jointly attending with the noised action rows.** This is the single closest thing I found to "the conditioning features get updated at each diffusion step based on the current noisy action estimate." Notable differences from your target: no 50% dropout of the self-conditioning signal (instead a Bernoulli(0.5) gate `α` on *context access*, a different thing), and the self-conditioned quantity is a distilled grounding/intent representation, not the previous action estimate or a RIN latent.

### 3. WCog-VLA — "self-condition feature" recomputed every denoising step, in driving
- **Title:** WCog-VLA: A Dual-Level World-Cognitive Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
- **arXiv:** 2607.08375 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08375 (submitted 2026-07-09)
- **Authors:** Xuerun Yan, Zhexi Lian, Nuoheng Zhang, Shiyu Fang, Haoran Wang, Chen Lv, Jia Hu, Binyang Song — **Tongji University + NTU Singapore**
- **Comments field:** `20 pages, 7 figures`. No code found.
- **Mechanism:** The ADDT head splits into a **condition encoder** and a **generation decoder** (adopting DDT, arXiv:2504.05741). At **every diffusion timestep t**, the condition encoder takes the **current noisy multi-agent action `x_t`** (fused with history and pooled VLM tokens) and outputs a **"semantic self-condition feature" `z_t = Encoder(F_at, t, S, F_VLM)`**; the decoder then denoises via `x_{t−1} = Decoder(F_at, t, z_t, F_VLM)` with `z_t` injected by AdaLN. A representation-alignment loss to a pretrained trajectory-VAE latent keeps `z_t` locally consistent across adjacent denoising steps.
- **Is the conditioning encoder re-run with the noisy action? YES — this is the one that genuinely does it.** A conditioning/semantic encoder is re-executed at each denoising step *with the current noisy action as input*, producing an updated conditioning vector. Caveat: the VLM perception backbone itself is frozen and run once; only the lightweight DiT condition encoder is re-run. And DDT's "self-condition" is a different lineage from Analog Bits — it means an encoder-produced semantic vector (shareable across adjacent steps for speed), not a fed-back `x̂₀` with dropout/stop-gradient.

**The DDT ancestor is worth naming directly:** DDT: Decoupled Diffusion Transformer, arXiv:2504.05741 (Shuai Wang, Zhi Tian, Weilin Huang, Limin Wang; comments field `sota on ImageNet256 and ImageNet512`), whose abstract says the decoupled architecture "enhances inference speed by enabling the **sharing self-condition between adjacent denoising steps**." That is image generation, not robotics, but it is the mechanism WCog-VLA imports into action generation.

### 4. ACoT-VLA — explicitly frames its action head as "self-conditioning transferred to action space"
- **Title:** ACoT-VLA: Action Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Models
- **arXiv:** 2601.11404 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11404 (v1 2026-01-16, v2 2026-03-30)
- **Authors:** Linqing Zhong, Yi Liu, Yifei Wei, Ziyu Xiong, Maoqing Yao, Si Liu, Guanghui Ren — **Beihang University + AgiBot**
- **Comments field:** `Accepted by Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026`
- **Code:** public — https://github.com/AgibotTech/ACoT-VLA
- **Mechanism:** An "Explicit Action Reasoner" (light flow-matching transformer cross-attending to the VLM KV-cache) first produces a **coarse reference action trajectory**, which is embedded and used as guidance for the main action head. The paper **explicitly cites Analog Bits [10]**: "this formulation can be viewed as an **action-space transfer of self-conditioning in generative models**, where incorporating prior estimates into the generation process has been shown to markedly improve sample quality." Training uses teacher forcing (ground-truth reference) for stability; inference switches to "fully **self-conditioned** mode."
- **Is the conditioning encoder re-run with the noisy action? NO.** This is a two-stage coarse-to-fine cascade of *two different networks*, executed once — not a per-denoising-step feedback loop. The self-conditioning framing is an analogy the authors draw, not the Analog Bits algorithm. Still: **this is the paper that most explicitly claims the "self-conditioning → action generation" conceptual territory in a top venue.**

### 5. HMPDM — self-conditioning (Analog Bits, cited) in driving *video* prediction
- **Title:** HMPDM: A Diffusion Model for Driving Video Prediction with Historical Motion Priors
- **arXiv:** 2603.27371 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27371 (submitted 2026-03-28)
- **Authors:** Ke Li, Tianjia Yang, Kaidi Liang, Xianbiao Hu, Ruwen Qin — **Stony Brook + Penn State**
- **Comments field:** empty. **Code public:** https://github.com/KELISBU/HMPDM
- **Mechanism:** Lists "(iii) a **Self-Conditioning (SC) strategy for stable iterative denoising**" as one of three named contributions, with a dedicated §III-C and a direct citation of Chen/Zhang/Hinton Analog Bits. **But the generated modality is future video frames, not actions.** No action head.

## Loose analogues (verified to exist, but NOT the mechanism)

These all matched the grep but use "self-conditioned" in the **autoregressive-rollout / exposure-bias** sense (model conditions on its *own previous timestep* output), which is a completely different axis from denoising-step self-conditioning. Do not mistake these for prior art:

- **2603.25685** Persistent Robot World Models (RL post-training under "self-conditioned rollout")
- **2603.07799** MWM: Mobile World Models — "self-conditioned action rollout contexts"
- **2605.07288** Sword — Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping, gradual switch from teacher forcing to self-conditioned latents
- **2606.27364** PhysiFormer — self-conditioned vs GT-conditioned AR rollout ablation
- **2601.03517** Semantic Belief-State World Model — fixed-point collapse "under self-conditioning"
- **2602.00440** DISK — "chain-of-forward self-conditioning"
- **2606.31226** ForgeDrive — scheduled sampling / "autoregressive self-conditioning"
- **2509.21983** Hybrid Diffusion Planning — "self-condition on a symbolic plan" (joint generation, one pass)
- **2511.12101** Freeze/Share/Shrink — "eePose self-conditioned" is an ablation naming, unrelated
- **2602.02142** FD-VLA — "self-conditioning through the residual path" in an attention block, unrelated
- **2404.02176**, **2405.19528**, **2505.07261**, **2509.06932**, **2512.22615** — Analog Bits appears **only in the bibliography**, never used in the method
- **2602.22862** GraspLDP, **2605.20433**, **2605.19957** — false positives on substring

## COULD-NOT-SUBSTANTIATE

- **RIN / Recurrent Interface Networks (2212.11972) as a robot action head or trajectory generator: ZERO hits.** arXiv API `all:"interface networks" AND all:"robot"` → total 0. Full-text `"Recurrent Interface"` across 3,383 robotics/driving papers → 0. **"Latent self-conditioning" as a phrase returns exactly one paper on all of arXiv: RIN itself.** Nobody has ported RIN latents to actions.
- **"Self-conditioning" + diffusion policy / manipulation / VLA in any abstract:** arXiv advanced search abstract-field `"self-conditioning"` AND {policy, robot, manipulation, action, trajectory, motion} returns at most 11 results total, none of them a robot action diffusion policy. `cat:cs.RO AND all:"self-conditioning"` → **total 0**.
- Canonical action-diffusion works verified to contain **zero** occurrences of "self-condition" in full text: Diffusion Policy (2303.04137), π0 (2410.24164), RDT-1B (2410.07864), Dita (2503.19757), 3D Diffuser Actor (2402.10885), 3D Diffusion Policy (2403.03954), DiffusionDrive (2411.15139), MotionDiffuser (2306.03083), Diffusion-ES (2402.06559), ManiFlow (2509.01819), Streaming Diffusion Policy (2406.04806), RNR-DP (2502.12724), MDT (2407.05996), One-Step DP (2410.21257), Crossway Diffusion (2307.01849), Diffusion-VLA (2412.03293), Motion Planning Diffusion (2308.01557), GoalFlow (2503.05689), DiffVLA (2505.19381), and ~15 more.
- No paper found using the phrases "recurrent denoising," "bidirectional conditioning diffusion policy," or "refine the conditioning" in a robot-policy abstract (all → 0 results).

## Brutally honest bottom line

**There is no paper that does exactly what you described** — Analog-Bits/RIN self-conditioning (previous `x̂₀` or previous latents fed back, 50% dropout, stop-gradient, double forward pass) applied to a robot **action** diffusion/flow head. That slot is empty.

What exists, and what you must cite and differentiate against:

1. **TrajFlow (2506.08541, IROS'25)** — the mechanism transplanted to *trajectory* generation with the right ingredients (50% probability, double forward pass, cites Analog Bits), but in autonomous-driving motion **forecasting**, training-only, context encoder cached and never re-run. This is your strongest "someone already did this one domain over" risk.
2. **INDI (2608.23478)** — literal stop-gradient + no-grad-pass + re-noise self-conditioning, on a **flow-matching VLA action expert (GR00T-N1.7 / π0.5)**, with states **carried across denoising steps at inference**. Applied to grounding/intent condition tokens rather than to the actions. This is the closest robotics prior art and the biggest novelty threat if your contribution is "self-condition the condition."
3. **WCog-VLA (2607.08375)** — the only one where a **conditioning encoder is genuinely re-executed at every denoising step with the current noisy action as input**, producing an updated condition vector `z_t`. Driving, not manipulation; inherits this from DDT (2504.05741) in image generation. If your idea is item #4 in your brief ("conditioning features updated at each diffusion step based on the current noisy action"), **this is a direct hit and you need to position against it.**
4. **ACoT-VLA (2601.11404, CVPR 2026)** — already publicly claims the phrase "action-space transfer of self-conditioning" with an Analog Bits citation, in a top venue with released code. Even though the actual algorithm is a coarse-to-fine two-network cascade, a reviewer will point at it.

Remaining genuine whitespace: RIN-style **latent** self-conditioning (persistent latent tokens carried across denoising steps) in any robot policy — completely untouched; and Analog-Bits self-conditioning **on the action tensor itself** inside a manipulation diffusion policy — also untouched.</result>

## 改动 ③（self-conditioning）判决

这份调研的覆盖是硬的——**3,383 篇 cs.RO/LG/CV 全文 grep `self.conditio*`，只有 23 篇命中**。这个数字本身就说明问题。

**四篇威胁，按严重程度：**

| 论文 | 威胁点 | 关键区别 |
|---|---|---|
**WCog-VLA**（2026-07，同济+NTU） | **⚠️ 直接命中**：condition encoder **每个去噪步用当前噪声动作重新执行**，产出 `z_t = Encoder(F_at, t, S, F_VLM)` | 驾驶不是操作；VLM backbone 冻结只跑一次；继承自 DDT（图像生成） |
**INDI / Act with Intent**（2026-08，POSTECH） | **⚠️ 最接近的机器人先例**：字面的 stop-gradient + no-grad 前向 + 重加噪，用在 **flow-matching VLA action expert（GR00T-N1.7 / π0.5）**上，且推理时跨去噪步携带 | 自条件的是 grounding/intent 表征，不是动作本身或 RIN latent |
**ACoT-VLA**（**CVPR 2026**，北航+智元，**有代码**） | **已公开宣称"action-space transfer of self-conditioning"** 并引 Analog Bits | 实际是粗到细的两网络级联，不是每步反馈 |
**TrajFlow**（**IROS 2025**，有代码） | 机制完全对（50% 概率、双次前向、引 Analog Bits） | **驾驶轨迹预测**；**训练期专用**；**context encoder 缓存不重跑** |

**剩下的真空隙（调研的原话）**：

> RIN 式的 **latent** self-conditioning（持久 latent token 跨去噪步携带）在任何机器人策略上——**完全未被触碰**；
> Analog-Bits 自条件**作用在动作张量本身**、在操作类 diffusion policy 里——**也未被触碰**。

**但注意 WCog-VLA 那条**：我提的改动 ③ 是"把动作嵌入拼进 QFormer 的 KV 侧重新算 condition"——**这正是 WCog-VLA 做的事**（只是它在驾驶、用 DDT 架构）。所以我原来的表述**不能直接用**，必须说清和它的区别。

---

## 四个改动的完整判决（三路查重齐了）

| 改动 | 判决 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
**① 预测未来动作序列作辅助目标** | **查重还在跑** | 待定 |

## 我必须纠正自己的两处技术错误

**1. 我把配方记错了。** 50% + stop-grad + 双次前向是 **Analog Bits**（Chen/Zhang/**Hinton**, ICLR 2023）的，**不是 RIN 的**。RIN 的自条件化率默认 **0.9**，而且 RIN 传的是**隐藏 latent**、Analog Bits 传的是 **x̂₀**。RIN 原文自己划了界。

**2. 更要命的设计问题**：我说"把 `x_t` 拼进 QFormer 的 KV"——**`x_t` 在去噪器侧本来就是输入，条件编码器再看一遍可能零信息增量**。应该注入 **x̂₀ 或中间 latent**。这是实质错误，不是措辞。

## 两个横跨所有改动的坏消息

**SelfWAM 的消融**：单加 action-conditioning 对策略成功率**几乎无提升**（"largely preserves the policy performance of FastWAM"），真正的提升来自 self-mask 监督。

**RIFT 的独立复现**（ANU，2026-08）：PFD 在 LIBERO 实测只有 **97.3**（自报 98.10），**LIBERO-Long 上与 Fast-WAM 完全打平（93.7 vs 93.7）**。

> **这条技术路线整体的效应量，可能比论文自报的小。**

## 但有一条反向证据值得注意

**Faster-WAM**（华科）给出反例：**分布偏移下，推理期保留未来条件把成功率从 49.14% 拉到 73.57%**。

这直接挑战 PFD（和我）共同的前提——"foresight 可以压缩进 current-only adapter"。**如果 Faster-WAM 对，那整个"推理时丢掉未来分支"的范式在 OOD 下就是错的。**

UD-VLA 测过"让动作看到视觉"并报告有害：

```
CALVIN:  Causal 4.04 / Bidirectional 4.32 / Hybrid 4.64
原文："explicitly prohibiting action-to-vision pathways... eliminates coarse action information leakage"
```

**但他们用的是朴素双向注意力——没有任何自条件化纪律**（无 dropout、无 stop-grad）。而 Analog Bits 的配方正是治这个病的标准药。

**所以故事是**："这个方向被报告有害，但那是因为缺了一个已知的纪律。加上它，看是否翻正。"

**go/no-go 实验很便宜**：先复现负结果（朴素拼接）→ 加 dropout + stop-grad → 看是否翻正。**翻不正就停手。**

## Key findings for your novelty assessment

1. **Your item 3 is heavily occupied.** Three papers independently do "lightweight module on a frozen base predicts the CFG result in one pass": **AGD (2503.07274, TMLR 2025, ETH, code public)**, **Plug-and-Play Diffusion Distillation (2406.01954, CVPR 2024, Adobe)**, and **cfgUP (PAKDD 2026, no arXiv, code 404)**. AGD is the strongest and most citable.

2. **The specific "learn the difference term explicitly" framing has 2026 prior art.** Both **2607.24731 (Alibaba Qwen)** and **2606.00798 (DASH)** independently prove that supervising only the *combined* guided output leaves the two branches **non-identifiable** — and both propose supervising the CFG direction/gap separately as the fix. If your contribution is "treat `(v_cond − v_uncond)` as a distillation target," these two papers already state the motivating theorem.

3. **Your item 5 (difference of two passes of the same model differing only in conditioning, as a target for a student lacking that conditioning) is the least occupied.** No paper I verified frames it that way. Existing work either (a) distills the *combined* output, or (b) moves guidance into the text embedding, or (c) keeps the student conditioned. This is the most defensible angle — but 2607.24731's PDM is the nearest neighbour and should be read closely.

4. **Terminology trap:** "guidance distillation" (Meng lineage — halves NFE per step) is routinely conflated with "CFG-aware step distillation" (SnapFusion/CoDi — CFG as a *regularizer* inside step distillation, does not halve NFE). Keep these separate in your related-work section.

5. **Chronology correction:** Imagen Video (2210.02303, 5 Oct 2022) predates Meng et al. (2210.03142, 6 Oct 2022) by one day. Concurrent, not a follow-up.

### 一、必须先纠正你的两条前提(源码级,影响判决)

我拉了 `github.com/Selen-Suyue/WoG/action_model/models.py` 核实:

**1. `per_attn` 不是"xavier 初值没被训动",而是 zero-init by design。** L141-145 注释就写着 `# zero initialization trick`,把 `in_proj_weight/bias`、`out_proj.weight/bias` **全部置 0**。

这直接反转了 E1 的论证逻辑:你原本想说"WoG 没有 adaLN-Zero,所以加上它能涨点";但 `O^c` 通路**已经是零初始化门控**了。你测到的 7.0% 门开度不是"初始化失败",而是**零门从 0 张开到了 7%** —— 这是零初始化的正常行为,不是 bug。`out_proj` 在 24 层里"几乎恒定 31.43~32.23"也需要重新解释(那是 `norm3` 的 LayerNorm 权重,L147,它**有** `elementwise_affine`,初值全 1)。

**2. `obs_dropout_prob` 默认是 0.75,不是 0。** L192 默认 0.75,被上层覆写成 `0 if train_venc else 1` —— 是**阶段开关**(全开/全关),不是"不 dropout"。E3 的表述要据此重写。

同时确认你对的地方:`norm1/norm2/norm_final` 全是 `elementwise_affine=False`,**无任何 modulate**,WoG 全文 "adaLN"/"dropout" 各出现 **0 次**。

### 三、C 组

**C1/C2 撞在同一篇:CoMo (2505.17006, CVPR 2026, 南大+上海AI Lab)。** 我亲自 grep 了全文,逐字确认:

- **Td** = "we **remove the direct encoding of future frames** and replace it with **feature differences between current and future frame** before the encoder input" —— 这就是 C1,三要素(特征差分/删掉未来帧/当前帧作 context)一个不差,连动机(抑制 static background shortcut)都一样。
- **Tcl** = "negative pairs are formed by **directly reversing the temporal direction**",InfoNCE,负样本 `Z_{t+n,t}` —— 这就是 C2。

C2 还在 VLA 层被第二次占位:**ConLA (2602.00557)** 的论证是"反转帧序时运动信息剧变、内容不变",与你的数学论证一字不差。通用视频 SSL 层更早:Shuffle&amp;Learn (1603.08561)、O3N (1611.06646)、IIC (2008.02531)。

C1 另有 **Mantis (2511.16175)** 的 DiT residual connection(架构上等价)、**DeltaTok (2604.04913, CVPR 2026)**、**StaMo (2510.05057)**、**What Matters for Latent Actions (2608.19613)** —— 后者已系统消融过 ΔDINO vs ΔRGB vs optical flow,结论"ΔDINO 一致优于 ΔRGB"。

**Delta-JEPA (2606.31232) 威胁反而低**:它是从潜在位移**反解动作**(displacement→action)的正则项,方向与 C1 相反。

**C3 是三个里唯一站得住的。** LEACE (2306.03819, NeurIPS 2023) 六年引用全在 NLP/fairness/interpretability,**没有一篇进入机器人/world model/VLA**。机器人侧处理"静态污染"的手段全是**训练时**的(VQ 瓶颈、特征差分、对比负样本、mask、因果去偏微调),「零训练闭式后处理线性擦除」这一格完全空着。

&gt; ⚠️ 但 C3 有个自噬风险:你自己测的**因果效应 96%~108% 来自未来独有成分**,说明那 83% 静态方差**本来就没在起作用**。擦掉一个不起作用的东西,大概率测出来是平的。C3 应当作为**因果验证工具**卖,不是作为涨点方法卖。

---

### 四、D 组

**最危险的一篇是 ForeTime-VLA (2608.20735)** —— 我读了全文,它在 VLA 场景里**同时**落地了 D1+D2:teacher code 是 **per-dimension whitened** 的,损失含 **teacher-causal cosine + per-dimension variance + off-diagonal covariance (=VICReg 三项) + pairwise action-geometry Gram**。related work 原话:"Our future cosine loss transfers instance-level direction, while a **Gram-matrix loss transfers batch geometry**"。你的 related work 不提它会被抓。

**D2 的故事已被完整讲过**:VideoREPA (2505.23656) 明确论证"REPA 的逐 token cosine 是 hard alignment → 换成 pairwise similarity 的 soft guidance",只是在 T2V 而非 VLA。祖宗齐全:RKD (1904.05068)、SP (1907.09682)、CRD (1910.10699)。

**D3 最拥挤**:WA-JEPA (2608.20974) 与 Flow-JEPA (2608.29029) 同月独立做了"用 conditional flow matching 替代确定性回归预测未来 latent"。

**D4 —— 你最想确认的那个,必须诚实说两件事:**

1. **"均权是错的"这个批评,ICLR 2023 摘要级别就提出过。** FCFD (2304.11832) 原文:"L2 distance is **isotropic** w.r.t. all dimensions, the neural network's operation on different dimensions is usually **anisotropic**"。这不能当新发现卖。

2. **"按对输出的功能重要性选方向蒸馏"已被做过:Flex-KD (2507.10155)。** 我核实了摘要原文:"the relevance of a representation dimension is determined **solely by how it affects the model's output**"、"should retain **dominant directions of functional contribution**, naturally inducing an **effective functional dimension**"。**这与你的"前 8 主方向占 97.7% 因果效应,应该只蒸这些"是同一个命题。**

**D4 剩下的真空白(三条同时成立):**
- **连续谱加权**(Mahalanobis 式 `Σᵢwᵢ‖vᵢᵀ(ŷ−y)‖²`) vs Flex-KD 的**硬 top-k 截断**
- 权重来自**干预式因果效应**(你测的 DiT 输出敏感度) vs Flex-KD 的**梯度一阶敏感度**
- 场景是 VLA 条件空间(首次)

要立住,**必须把 Flex-KD 式硬 top-k 做成直接 baseline 并打赢**,否则一句"这就是 Flex-KD 换个重要性估计器"就被打掉。

---

### 五、E 组

**E1 是常识,而且你的论证有归因陷阱。** DiT 原论文我核实了完整四行:in-context 35.24 / cross-attn 26.14 / **plain adaLN 25.21** / adaLN-Zero 19.47。**plain adaLN (25.21) ≈ cross-attn (26.14),只差 0.93** —— 真正收益全来自 **zero-init**(25.21→19.47),不是"换注入形式"。而 WoG 的 cross-attn **已经是 zero-init 的**(源码 L141)。用 19.47 vs 26.14 论证 E1 是过度解读。

精确前作:**DiT-Block Policy (2410.10088, Levine 组)** 已经做过"诊断 cross-attn 注入导致糟糕训练动态 → 换 adaLN-Zero"的完整叙事,含四路消融。

反证两篇(方向相反):**Dita (2503.19757, ICCV 2025)** 附录 Table 7 显示 in-context **2.56 vs AdaLN 1.45**;**HiMoE-VLA (2512.05693)** 三路几乎打平且 in-context 略胜。

VLA 条件注入对照表(12 个模型中**只有 3 个**真用 adaLN):π0 **否**(π0.5 才加 adaRMS)、RDT-1B 否、Diffusion Policy-T 否、GR00T N1 是、**CogACT 否**(其 `modulate()` 是死代码,WoG 逐字继承了这份代码)、Octo 否、OpenVLA-OFT 否、Dita 否、DiT-Block Policy 是。**"DiT action head = adaLN" 是误解;WoG 的 no-adaLN 是 CogACT 这一支的有意传承。**

**E2 已被 OpenWAM (2609.07398) 系统做过,且结论反直觉。** 你的 87.41 vs 92.39 属实(Isolated vs Action-Sees-Video),但:**从头训时 Mutual 比 Action-Sees-Video 还差 0.24pp,只有经过具身预训练后才翻转**。且它是**混合自注意力的 mask 分块**,不是 cross-attention。残留空白极窄:OpenWAM 刻意把 VLM 语义流设为 read-only tail 且**没消融打开它**。

**E3 有窄空白但风险明确。** Composer 配方我核实了逐字:独立 dropout **0.5**/全丢 0.1/全留 0.1,intensity 图像特殊用 **0.7**,理由是"contain the vast majority of information and may underweight other conditions" —— 与 E3 论证同构,**引用正确**。另有 V-Express (2406.02511) 标题即《Conditional Dropout》,非对称 50%/20%。真空白:无 VLA 论文报告过差异化 dropout 消融,且 **0.0 这个边界从未被研究**。但 **History-Guided Video Diffusion (2502.06764, ICML 2025)** 带消融证明**对多帧富信息条件做二值 dropout 是次优的,token 越多越差** —— 而 `O^c` 恰是 16 token。

---

### 六、最终判断:哪 2-3 个最可能是真贡献

**第一名:D4(因果谱加权蒸馏)。** 唯一一个「有独占诊断数据 + 空白真实存在 + 可能真涨点」三者齐备的。你的 97.7%/TwoNN=4.94/effective rank=14.0 是别人没有的弹药,且 cosine 均权 512 坐标与因果效应集中在 8 维之间的失配是**可量化的浪费**。叙事必须改成「重要性应由**干预式因果效应**定义,且应**连续加权而非硬截断**」,并把 Flex-KD 做成 baseline。

**第二名:C3(LEACE 零训练擦除)。** 空白最干净(六年零跨领域迁移),成本最低(闭式,零训练)。但**必须按"因果验证工具/可解释性诊断"来写**,不能按"涨点"写 —— 你自己的 96%~108% 诊断预示了它大概率不涨点。

**第三名(有保留):E3 的 0.0 边界。** 这是唯一没被人碰过的具体数值格子,但它本质是超参消融,撑不起主贡献,且 ICML 2025 那篇已经预告了二值 dropout 在 16-token 条件上会是次优解。

**建议放弃:C1、C2、D1、D2、D3、E1、E2。** 七个都有 2025-2026 年的直接前作,其中 CoMo(CVPR 2026)、VideoREPA、OpenWAM、ForeTime-VLA 四篇可见度高,被审稿人查出的概率接近 1。C1/C2 建议降级为"我们验证了 CoMo 的 Td/Tcl 迁移到 condition space"的复现性 ablation,并**主动引用而非回避**。

**另外两件事值得单独做**:(1) 你测的「`O^c` 因果作用 96%~108% 来自未来独有成分」与 **PFD (2604.25859)** 形式化的"foresight residual"高度呼应,但 PFD 是在动作去噪方向上做残差,**没人在压缩条件空间上做过这个测量** —— 这个诊断本身可能比十个改动都更有论文价值。(2) WoG 的 ICML 2026 venue 在 abs 页**无记载**(Comments 仅 "Project Page"),需去项目页确认后再引。</result>

    """

    def __init__(self, hidden_size, num_heads, mlp_ratio=4.0, use_per_attn=False, **block_kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
        self.attn = Attention(hidden_size, num_heads=num_heads, qkv_bias=True, **block_kwargs)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
        mlp_hidden_dim = int(hidden_size * mlp_ratio)

        def approx_gelu():
            return nn.GELU(approximate="tanh")

        self.mlp = Mlp(in_features=hidden_size, hidden_features=mlp_hidden_dim, act_layer=approx_gelu, drop=0)

        self.use_per_attn = use_per_attn
        if self.use_per_attn:
            self.per_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
                embed_dim=hidden_size,
                num_heads=num_heads,
                bias=True,
                batch_first=True,
            )

            # zero initialization trick
            nn.init.constant_(self.per_attn.in_proj_weight, 0.0)
            nn.init.constant_(self.per_attn.in_proj_bias, 0.0)
            nn.init.constant_(self.per_attn.out_proj.weight, 0.0)
            nn.init.constant_(self.per_attn.out_proj.bias, 0.0)

            self.norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, eps=1e-6)

    def forward(self, x, per_token):
        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x))

        if self.use_per_attn:
            assert per_token is not None

            x_c, _ = self.per_attn(self.norm3(x), per_token, per_token)
            x = x + x_c

        x = x + self.mlp(self.norm2(x))
        return x

## 我的两处错误

**错误 1：`out_proj` 不是被 xavier 覆盖的。**
`nn.MultiheadAttention` 的 `out_proj` 是 `NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear`，**不匹配 `isinstance(module, nn.Linear)` 的检查**，所以 `_basic_init` 根本没碰它。它一开始就是 32——那是 `nn.MultiheadAttention` 自己的默认初始化，**`nn.init.constant_(..., 0.0)` 那一行没生效**（或者被 `_reset_parameters` 覆盖了）。

**错误 2：我把 `norm3` 的 LayerNorm 权重误读成了证据。**
`norm3` 的范数恒为 **32.0000**（= √1024，全 1 向量），而它**有** `elementwise_affine`。我看到的"out_proj 在 24 层里恒定 31.43~32.23"其实是同一个数量级的巧合。

## 但有一件事没变，而且更清楚了

```
训练后（WoG-V）：per_in = 2.833
未训练：        per_in = 0.0000
```

**`in_proj_weight` 确实是真正的零初始化门，而且它从 0 张开到了 2.833。** 所以：

| 说法 | 判定 |
|---|---|
"per_attn 是 ControlNet 式零初始化门" | ✅ 对，但门只在 `in_proj` 上 |
"门开度 7.0%（相对同层 qkv）" | ✅ 数字对 |
"out_proj 的零初始化被 xavier 覆盖" | ❌ **错**，是 `NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear` 不匹配 isinstance |
"门开到 7% 说明它没学起来" | ❌ **错**，零门张开到 7% 是正常行为，不是失败 |

**这直接反转了 E1 的论证**：我原本想说"WoG 没有 adaLN-Zero，加上能涨点"。但 `O^c` 通路**本来就是零初始化门控**——那份调研还指出 DiT 原论文的真正收益来自 zero-init（25.21→19.47），而不是"换注入形式"（plain adaLN 25.21 ≈ cross-attn 26.14，只差 0.93）。

# 查重报告：WoG 两组改动

**一句话结论：A 组的 A1/A2/A3 三个子项各自都已被明确占据（FlexLAM / LightVLA+KATok / FONDUE），B 组 B1 是 bug、B2 是 2022 年已解决的疏漏、B3 被五篇以上论文分食。但两组的残值性质不同——B 组是"修 bug"，A 组里有一个真正未被占的经验发现。**

---

## 〇、基线核实

**(A) 已验证** `arXiv:2602.22010` · 2026-02-25 · ByteDance Seed + HKU · **代码已开源** `github.com/Selen-Suyue/WoG`

⚠️ 更正一处：arXiv abs 页 Comments 字段**只写了 "Project Page"，没有 ICML 2026**。但我拉取了项目页 `selen-suyue.github.io/WoGNet/`，页面上明确标有 **"ICML 2026"**。所以 venue 成立，只是别从 arXiv 引。

---

## 一、A 组判决

### A1 — 变长 condition（反转方向的 nested dropout）

**判决：(c) 大部分已做，残缝极窄。**

**(A) 已验证的致命对手** — [FlexLAM 2606.19408](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19408) · 2026-06-17 · Yoshimoto/Hu/Kondo/Matsushima（东大松尾研系）· **Comments 字段为空 = 未发表 preprint** · **无公开代码**

我拉了全文逐句核对。FlexLAM = **nested dropout 训练变长 latent action，prefix-valid**，摘要原文自称 "architecture-free, **drop-in upgrade** to the fixed-capacity bottleneck in latent action models, **latent-action world models**, and video-pretrained action interfaces"。它的 §4.1 标题就叫 "Retained-Prefix Training for Prefix-Valid Latent Actions"。

**但它明确划了自己的边界**，related work 原文：
&gt; "FlexLAM applies this principle to **action-free transition codes rather than image tokens or policy action tokens**."

全文 **0 次**出现 "Q-Former"/"QFormer"，**0 次** "intrinsic dimension"。对象是 LAM（两帧间 transition 码），不是 WoG 的"未来观测压缩条件 → DiT 每层 cross-attn KV"。

**残缝的精确表述**：变长 condition 在「压缩式未来观测条件编码器」上没人做过；且所有现成方法（FlexLAM / [FlexTok 2502.13967](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.13967) ICML 2025 Apple+EPFL / [One-D-Piece 2501.10064](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10064) ICML 2025 / [ElasticTok 2410.08368](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08368) / [MQT 2405.19315](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.19315)）**一律丢尾部保前缀**。

**A1 的"方向反转"是它唯一的独立性来源，但这里有一个会杀死它的反驳**：FlexLAM 全文指出其目标函数"gives earlier tokens denser training pressure"——**前置性是被训练强制出来的，不是数据固有的**。所以审稿人会直接问：**为什么不直接把标准 prefix nested dropout 加到 WoG 上，让训练把信息重新推到前面？** 你必须先跑这个对照，否则"反转方向"站不住。

### A2 — 每样本自适应 query 数（Gumbel-ST + 稀疏惩罚）

**判决：(a) 已做过。机制在 VLA 内部已被发表。**

- **(A) 已验证** [LightVLA 2509.12594](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.12594) · 2025-09-16 · 理想汽车+中科院计算所 · Comments: "Under review"。摘要逐字："generates **dynamic queries** to evaluate visual token importance, and adopts **Gumbel softmax** to enable differentiable token selection … requires **no heuristic magic numbers**"。**这就是 A2 的机制，且已在 VLA 内。**
- **(A) 已验证** [KATok 2608.24293](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24293) · 2026-08-25。"adaptive token selector jointly learned with latent tokens"，keep-or-drop 概率 + 稀疏正则消融 + token 数分布图。
- **(A) 已验证** [AdaSlot 2406.09196](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09196) · **CVPR 2024**。Gumbel-Softmax + mean-field 分解动态 slot 数。
- **(A) 已验证** [Dynamic Query Selection for Fast Visual Perceiver 2205.10873](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.10873) · **CVPR 2022 Transformer for Vision workshop**。**最老且最贴架构**：Perceiver 有序 latent query 随机前缀训练 + 逐样本自适应选 K。**"Perceiver latent query 数逐样本自适应" 2022 年就有了。**

A2 剩下的只是"LightVLA 选的是输入视觉 token 子集，不是 condition 瓶颈 query"这条组合式差异。**这是机制已知 + 换对象，不是贡献。**

### A3 — 用实测 d_eff≈5 指导瓶颈大小

**判决：(a) 已做过，且时机最差。**

- **(A) 已验证** [FONDUE 2209.12806](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.12806) · 2022-09-26。摘要开篇即"determining the optimal number of latent variables is mostly done by grid search: a costly process"，用 IDE 直接算出该用多少维。**这就是 A3 的摘要，只是对象是 VAE。**
- **(A) 已验证** [2608.19613 What Matters for Latent Actions in Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19613) · 2026-08-20。**机器人领域已被占**：41 个设计选择、59M 帧 OXE，专设一问"最合适的 latent action 维度"，答案 d_z=8~32。而且它警告 proxy metrics **不能跨维度比较**——直接削弱"用一个标量定维"。
- **⚠️ (A) 已验证，对 A3 致命** — [2604.20276 Rethinking Intrinsic Dimension Estimation in Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20276) · 2026-04-22 · LMU Munich · Comments: **"Accepted at AISTATS 2026"**。论点：常用 ID 估计器"heavily biased in high dimensions"且"**provably not tracking the true underlying IDs**"，并主张它们实际反映的是"**how variance is distributed across linear directions**"。

**这意味着你的 TwoNN=4.94 可能被判定为没有提供超出 effective rank=14 / PR=9 的独立信息。** 注意你自己的对照恰好印证了风险：同协方差高斯给 15.85 而非 4.94——你必须把这个 gap 归因于非线性弯曲，而这篇会说它来自高维估计偏差。你的 5 维合成流形对照（4.80）是唯一的正面防御，务必保留。

**另外：** [OneWM-VLA 2605.07931](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07931)（已验证，2026-05-08）发现每帧压到 **1 个 token 长程性能不降**。这既支持 A3 的"容量过剩"前提，也**削弱其价值**——"砍容量"已被证明可行且不涨点。

### 🔑 A 组里唯一真正未被占的东西：**信息后置的经验发现**

**这不是 A1/A2/A3 中的任何一个，而是你的诊断本身。**

支持你的证据：[One-D-Piece 2501.10064](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10064) 全文原文说无 ordering 正则的 TiTok 呈现 "**mostly random peaks**"——即文献认为**不加正则 = 无序**。没人报告过「**因果掩码 + 零 ordering 正则 → 单调后置**」。你的 Spearman +0.841、后缀恒优于前缀、扰动 query#8 对 token 0-7 影响精确 0.000000，我**未找到先例**。

但有三条必须预处理的反驳：
1. **机制平凡**：因果掩码下后位 token 感受野严格更大，后置近乎定义成立。审稿人会说 trivial。
2. **(A) 已验证的邻近先例** [2412.17483](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.17483)（2024-12，人大+腾讯）的"Lost by the boundary"：压缩模型呈现"higher perplexity at the start of the segment and **lower perplexity toward the end**"，方向一致。
3. **(A) 已验证** [PRIOR 2606.25232](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25232) · Comments: **"Accepted to ICANN 2026 main proceedings"**。已在讨论 late-token utility，并给出"ordering pressure 完全依赖 gradient exposure"的机制论断——**既是竞品，也是你可直接借用的理论框架**。

---

## 二、B 组判决

### B1 — pad_mask 修复末端帧塌缩
**(d) 学术上无人写，但它是数据加载器标准实践（LeRobot 已内置 pad flag），只是 WoG 没用。可发表性≈零。**
**但它是前置条件**：不修 B1，B2/B3 的任何增益都会被归因为"你只是修了重复帧"。必须作为共同基线，不是三个并列改进之一。

### B2 — QFormer KV 侧加时间嵌入
**(a) 已做，且 2022 年就有明确动机的标准做法。这是最硬的坏消息。**

- **(A) 已验证** [Flamingo 2204.14198](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14198) · Comments: **"54 pages. NeurIPS 2022"**。§2.1 原文："frames are … encoded independently to obtain a 3D spatio-temporal grid of features **to which learned temporal embeddings are added**" 然后才进 Perceiver Resampler。
- **(A) 已验证** [Video-LLaMA 2306.02858](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.02858) · Comments: **"Accepted by EMNLP 2023's demo track"**。原文："**Since the frame representations … are computed without considering any temporal information, we further apply position embeddings as the indicator of temporal information**" 然后喂 Video Q-Former。**与 B2 在架构位置上逐字同构。**
- **(A) 已验证** [STEP 2503.24298](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.24298) · Comments: **"Accepted to ICRA 2026"**。已把置换不变性形式化："our analysis shows that **probing is permutation-invariant and blind to frame order**"，解法 = frame-wise PE，近对称动作涨 4-10%。

**B2 不是开放问题，是 WoG 的实现疏漏。**唯一残值：对 WoG 做 **permutation test**（打乱/倒序 5 帧 KV，看 O^c 和动作是否不变）。那能产出"SOTA VLA 的世界模型条件对时间方向完全失明"的硬证据——但价值在**揭示基线缺陷**，不在方法新颖性。

### B3 — 非均匀/事件驱动未来帧采样
**(c) 大部分已做，缝很窄。**

- **(A) 已验证** [KEMO 2606.23589](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23589) · 2026-06-22 · Comments 空。**直接做了你想做的 ablation**，摘要原文："Ablations show that **event-driven keyframe selection outperforms uniform sampling** and recent-frame retention"。机制也一一对应：机器人运动学（夹爪）+ 视觉过滤检测 event → 编码成"compact **temporally ordered** memory tokens" → cross-attention + gated fusion。**它还顺手覆盖了 B2。** 唯一差异：**KEMO 选过去帧（memory），B3 选未来帧（condition）。**
- **(A) 已验证** [UVD 2310.08581](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08581)（Comments 空，通称 ICRA 2024，有代码）：用预训练视觉表征的 embedding 相变无监督发现 subgoal。**B3"非均匀选帧"的最强通用先例**——审稿人第一个问题就是"和 UVD 选帧有什么区别"。
- **(A) 已验证** [AWE 2307.14326](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.14326)（真实标题 *Waypoint-Based Imitation Learning for Robotic Manipulation*，Stanford，有代码）：2023 年就立了"均匀采样不是最优时间抽象"。
- **(A) 已验证** [SuSIE 2310.10639](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10639)（真实标题 *Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation with Pretrained Image-Editing Diffusion Models*，Berkeley RAIL）：固定间隔——**它是被批评的一方，不是先例**。批评者：TaKSIE（WACV 2025）[2410.11013](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11013)、CLOVER（NeurIPS 2024）[2409.09016](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.09016)。
- **(A) 已验证** [AHA-WAM 2606.09811](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09811) · 2026-06-08：核心主张"现有 world-action model 把世界预测和动作执行绑在同一时间分辨率上"——**几乎就是你想对 WoG 均匀采样提的批评**。

⚠️ AWE/UVD/KEMO/SuSIE 的 Comments 字段**都没写 venue**，别凭记忆在 related work 里写会议名。

## WoG 做对的三件事

**一、它把 latent 空间的定义权交给了下游**

Stage-I 的 loss 只有 `act_loss`。没有重建、没有对比、没有任何"像未来"的约束。

**这意味着 `O^c` 完全由"对动作生成有用"定义出来。** 这跟绝大多数工作不一样——VPP、DreamVLA、Seer 都是先定一个预测目标（像素/DINO 特征/深度），再指望它对动作有用。**WoG 反过来，让动作 loss 自己去塑造这个空间。**

这是一个真正的立场，不是工程选择。

**二、它敢把瓶颈压到 16×32**

288 个 KV token 压到 512 个数。而且论文自己消融过 16 vs 64，**发现 16 更好、64 会 overfit 到无关视觉细节**。

**这说明作者知道"压缩本身是有价值的"**，不是被迫压缩，是主动选择。

**三、它承认了 latent 的用途会变**

两阶段设计的本质是：Stage-I 用 `O^c` 引导动作，Stage-II 改用它塑造 `z`。**同一个 latent，先当条件，后当靶子。**

这是个不常见的设计，而且它隐含承认了一件事——**latent 的价值不在它自己，在它能塑造什么**。

## 所以标题里那个词是认真的

`World Modeling in **Condition Space**` —— 而不是 "in pixel space" 或 "in latent action space"。

**它在主张：世界模型该建在"条件"这个层面上。** 而条件空间是个被下游定义的、压缩的、可以中途换用途的东西。

---

而它在**概念层面**是清醒的：把 latent 的定义权交给下游、主动压缩、承认用途会变。

你说不用追着 DINO/VGGT 说，但我认为**那个实验才是你真正的起点**，因为它不属于任何人的框架。

它测出的事情是：

```
DINOv2 → MLP → Cosmos decoder        成功
VGGT depth → MLP → Cosmos decoder    部分成功（结构在，颜色丢）
Cosmos-ci → MLP → VGGT depth         部分成功

```

**这四个结果拼起来，是一张"谁能读懂谁"的表。** 而 MLP 没有容量，所以这张表反映的是信息本身，不是提取能力。

## 这张表如果做大，就是一个真问题

现在所有人都在造 latent（DINOv2、VGGT、Cosmos、V-JEPA、SigLIP…），每个都声称自己的表征"通用"。

**但没有人系统地问过：这些 latent 之间，谁包含谁？**

如果把这张表做全——N 个编码器 × M 个解码器，全部用无容量的线性桥——你会得到一张**表征之间的信息包含关系图**。

而这张图能回答的问题是：

- "通用表征"是不是真的通用，还是只是在某些读法下通用
- 一个 latent 的价值，能不能脱离消费者定义
- 哪些表征其实是冗余的（互相可读）

## 为什么这个不是"改别人的东西"

因为它**不改任何模型**。它是一把尺子，量的是整个领域产出的所有 latent。

而且它跟 WoG 是连着的——WoG 说"latent 该由下游定义"，这张表如果显示"不同下游读出的东西差异巨大"，那就是对 WoG 立场的独立验证；如果显示"大家读出的差不多"，那 WoG 的立场就被削弱了。**两个方向都是结论。**

- Submitted: **18 May 2026** (v1)
- Comments: `Project Page at this https URL`
- Subjects: cs.CV
- Benchmark contributed: **SysCON3D** (controlled corruption benchmark for multiview 3D consistency metrics). Backbones tested: VGGT, DUSt3R, MASt3R, Fast3R.
- **CLOSE-RANGE / OBJECT-SCALE: NO.** Scene-level only — DL3DV-10K-Benchmark (24 scenes) + Mip-NeRF360 (9 scenes). DTU/object-centric metrics are only cited as related work, never run.

Exact failure sentences (hallucination axis — strongest in the set):
&gt; "Our analysis shows that VGGT, MASt3R, DUSt3R, and Fast3R can hallucinate dense geometry and cross-view support for unrelated scenes, repeated images, and random noise."

&gt; "Learned 3D backbones, including VGGT, DUSt3R, MASt3R, and Fast3R, can return nontrivial 3D structure for inputs with no valid multiview geometry: unrelated scene mixtures, repeated images, and random noise."

&gt; "The overlap diagnostic makes this concrete: in the L3 setting, roughly 89% of view pairs are cross-scene pairs and should have zero overlap, yet DUSt3R reports zero overlap for only 26% of pairs, fabricating shared geometry for a large fraction of unrelated views."

&gt; "DUSt3R is the clearest failure: on L3, it reports only 26% zero-overlap, against an expected 89%, a −63 pp gap. At the same level, MASt3R, Fast3R, and VGGT still under-report zero-overlap by 21pp, 48pp, and 18pp."

&gt; "Gaussian noise is even more extreme: MASt3R, DUSt3R, and VGGT hallucinate overlap on every pair, and Fast3R still hallucinates overlap on 22.7% of Gaussian-noise pairs."

&gt; "Confidence is therefore only a weak failure signal" (uncertainty miscalibration axis).

&gt; "Our hallucination analysis reveals that each learned 3D reconstruction model tends to produce a characteristic fallback geometry under severely inconsistent inputs... the reconstructed geometry is remarkably stable across different noise realizations and numbers of views, indicating that it is dominated by the model prior rather than image evidence. VGGT, for instance, consistently produces a canopy-like structure, while MASt3R, DUSt3R, and Fast3R tend to reconstruct variants of a small set of approximately planar surfaces with model-specific spacing."

&gt; "Both MASt3R and VGGT instead link many low-residual correspondences" — on real NVS outputs (MVSplat360) where "generated content shares no perceptible geometric or semantic overlap – a case where any backbone should return very few matches."

&gt; "If the model hallucinates a plausible scene, a geometric check can end up validating that internal reconstruction rather than independent image evidence."

Synthetic: **custom ShapeNet-in-Blender object-centric dataset**, 13 categories (bag, basket, bathtub, bed, bench, bottle, bowl, cap, car, chair, earphone, jar), focal 24–100 mm, **explicit baseline strata: stereo/parallel, small (10–25°), medium (45–75°), large (90–120°) angular baseline**. This is the single best match for narrow-baseline + object-scale in the whole set.

Exact failure/limitation sentences:
&gt; "However, learned functional mappings are prone to fail in out-of-distribution cases. As the above models are trained on millions of samples, it is hard to track when a model acts out-of-distribution and how badly it fails in such cases."

&gt; "While there is a clear drop in matching heads, around 50% heads are still retained, indicating that the model does not ignore the occluded regions but recovers correspondences through some form of inpainting or hallucination."

&gt; "This non-zero matching indicates that the model hallucinates missing correspondences rather than ignoring the occluded areas. While hallucinations could be beneficial if correct, it is fundamentally impossible to resolve single-view ambiguity when one of the two images is occluded, making this behavior potentially undesirable for reconstruction tasks."

&gt; "However, VGGT exhibits a higher failure rate under large lighting and color changes, particularly for top-view lighting, which removes shadows from the scene, and for neon and rainbow lighting, which introduces color inconsistencies... It is specifically the case where only one view is intervened, it fails (Sampson error over 10 pixels) more often than for other modifications."

&gt; "VGGT outperforms baselines, even when only shadows disambiguate symmetric objects, but **fails on completely ambiguous scenes without shadows**." / "under fully symmetric lighting and object configurations, where no disambiguating signals are present, **all methods fail** as expected, confirming that the task is geometrically underconstrained."

&gt; Narrow-baseline caveat (important): "VGGT outperforms the baselines for the case of large viewpoint differences, but **performs on par with the baselines for stereo pair cameras**." / "For close stereo pairs, classical methods achieve lower median error when successful."

&gt; Limitations: "Our study focuses on synthetic data and certain camera configurations, so generalization to fundamentally different geometric and scene configurations remains unclear."

&gt; Conclusion: "our input perturbation experiments reveal that the models rely strongly on learned priors, which provide robustness to input variations but can also lead to undesirable hallucinations."

### 3. arXiv:2606.16479 — "Uncertainty Quality of VGGT: An Analysis on the DTU Benchmark Dataset" 【已核实】
- Authors: Markus Hillemann, Robert Langendörfer, Steven Landgraf, Markus Ulrich (KIT, Photogrammetry &amp; Remote Sensing)
- Submitted: **15 Jun 2026**
- Comments: `Accepted for publication in the ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences`
- Subjects: cs.CV; cs.AI
- **CLOSE-RANGE / OBJECT-SCALE: YES.** Entire study is **DTU** (15 scenes: 24,37,40,55,63,65,69,83,97,105,106,110,114,118,122) — object-centric tabletop, structured-light GT, sub-mm metrics. Best "uncertainty on object-scale" reference available.

Exact failure sentences (uncertainty miscalibration axis — most quantitative in the set):
&gt; "VGGT-d thus exhibits the typical phenomenon of overconfidence (Guo et al., 2017). However, the quality of the uncertainty prediction of VGGT-p is also suboptimal. For example, the probability that an inaccurate point will be rated as uncertain by the network is only 61.2%. Therefore, **inaccurate points cannot simply be removed based on filtering uncertain points**."

&gt; "The figure shows that the estimated uncertainties are suboptimal. For example, VGGT-d often provides a low uncertainty for points on the ground, even though these are often inaccurate. But even with VGGT-p, there are inaccurate points that are considered certain."

&gt; "Red points (inaccurate but certain) are the most problematic, as **overconfidence can lead to critical misjudgments**."

&gt; "the depth map branch suffers from overconfidence in particular."

&gt; "metric uncertainty quantification per predicted 3D point is currently not yet possible, but would be advantageous for many photogrammetric and metrology tasks and safety-critical applications."

Hard numbers (Table 3, mean over 15 DTU scenes): VGGT-p PAvPU 55.0%, pAC 80.6%, **pUI 61.2%**, AUSE 0.34. VGGT-d PAvPU 54.1%, **pAC 48.5%** (worse than chance), pUI 53.9%, **AUSE 0.72**. Reconstruction (Table 1/2): VGGT-p CD 0.59 mm, VGGT-d CD 0.97 mm vs MASt3R 0.37, COLMAP 0.53, DUSt3R 1.74 — i.e. **DUSt3R is 3–4× worse than COLMAP on object-scale DTU**. Also: "Accuracy is good on flat surfaces but tends to be poorer for points directly at edges of the 3D geometry."

### 5. arXiv:2609.18465 — "GeoCond: A Conditioning-Aware Reliability Adapter for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction" 【已核实】
- Authors: David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Mohammad Ali Armin, Russell Tsuchida, Lars Petersson (CSIRO + Monash)
- Submitted: **16 Sep 2026**
- Comments: **(none / empty Comments field)**
- Subjects: cs.CV
- **CLOSE-RANGE / OBJECT-SCALE: NO.** 7-Scenes (heads/chess/office, indoor room-scale), MegaUnScene, MegaDepth-1500, ScanNet-1500.
- **This is the best narrow/small-baseline + uncertainty-miscalibration quantification in the whole set.**

Exact failure sentences:
&gt; "Feed-forward 3D foundation models such as VGGT predict cameras, depth, and point maps in a single pass, but **can fail silently under low overlap, low parallax, and extreme relative rotation**. Stratified analyses over these factors show that these failures are governed by geometric conditioning and are **poorly captured by native aleatoric confidence**."

&gt; "On 7-Scenes, pose error is strongly parallax-dependent: the median pairwise error increases from approximately **3.0° at high parallax to 17.4° below 1° parallax, with 22% of low-parallax pairs becoming catastrophic failures above 30°**. The frame-permutation orbit variance tracks this degradation, while **VGGT's native aleatoric confidence remains weakly informative**."

&gt; "On MegaUnScene, for example, the median error rises from **3.3° to 44.2°**, while conditioning-based AUSE is 0.163 compared with **0.323 for native confidence**."

&gt; "A pair can contain many confident local predictions and still be globally ill-conditioned if the views barely overlap, the camera motion has little triangulation parallax, or a large relative rotation leaves weak correspondences. In these regimes, **the pose can fail while native confidence remains weakly informative**."

&gt; "On a frozen VGGT, **BA can improve pairs with sufficient track support but corrupt low-overlap pairs** whose geometric constraints are weak."

&gt; "we identify geometric conditioning as a primary driver of feed-forward relative-pose failure... and show that **native aleatoric confidence is a poor predictor of these pose-level errors**."

&gt; Limitation: "The signal helps most where native confidence is blind, such as **indoor low-parallax and low-overlap cases** and outdoor extreme-view data with large relative rotations."

Native-vs-conditioning AUSE table (Table 1): 7-Scenes heads 0.417 native / 0.172 cond.; chess 0.370/0.157; office 0.186/0.173; MegaUnScene 0.323/0.163; **MegaDepth-1500 0.616 native / 0.261 cond.**; ScanNet-1500 0.386/0.230. Also records "low par. err" 17.4/10.8/22.6/44.2/–/8.6 vs "high par. err" 3.0/2.7/10.0/3.3/–/2.2.

- Authors: Wenyan Cong, Yiqing Liang, Yancheng Zhang, Ziyi Yang, Yan Wang, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone, Chen Chen, Zhangyang Wang, Zhiwen Fan (UT Austin, Brown, UCF, NVIDIA, Stanford)

Paper itself states "**DTU focuses on object-centric tabletop scenes**" and datasets "span diverse scene scales from 0.2m to 85m" covering "both object-scale and scene-scale reconstruction."

Exact failure sentences:
&gt; "**In general, all methods perform worse on the object-centric DTU dataset, likely because their training data consists primarily of scene-level datasets, limiting their ability to generalize to object-level geometry and appearance.**" ← the single most useful quote for a manipulation-scale argument

&gt; "**GFMs struggle to generalize in domains with extreme data scarcity.** While GFMs show strong generalization to common out-of-distribution settings, such as aerial views, street-driving scenes, and egocentric perspectives, they often **fail in extreme cases like large altitude variation or wide-baseline air-ground pairs**, as seen in ULTRRA."

&gt; "On **long video sequences**, such as ScanNet-eval, ADT, and TUM Dynamics, **GFMs often exhibit increased rotation errors**, while driving scenes from KITTI Odometry pose challenges in the form of high ATE."

&gt; "**GFMs perform significantly worse on the real-world ULTRRA challenge, which involves air-ground input pairs.**"

&gt; "Due to the scarcity of metrically accurate training data, **GFMs often struggle to predict absolute depth**." / "in the metric-scale setting, **MASt3R and CUT3R fail to meet the strict threshold (e.g., &lt;3% error)**, highlighting the difficulty of accurate scale recovery under sparse inputs."

&gt; "When using test-time pose optimization, the optimized pose may still **fail to perfectly align with ground-truth, especially on datasets like DTU**. This misalignment is evident across all methods."

&gt; "**current GFMs are not yet ready for real-time deployment**... even the most efficient models still require tens of seconds to process 256 input views."

&gt; Conclusion: "several challenges remain—particularly in metric-scale depth prediction, sparse-view reconstruction, and real-time deployment."

Striking numbers (Table 4, multi-view relative pose): on **CO3Dv2 (object-centric)** VGGT gets **ATE 1.639 / RPE-trans 8.702 / RPE-rot 71.350** — by far the worst of all 12 methods (DUSt3R 0.903/1.325/4.312; Fast3R 0.698/1.035/4.352; CUT3R 0.847/1.209/6.361). On the ScanNet&amp;ADT&amp;TUM-Dyn long-sequence column VGGT is **0.654/0.425/30.787** vs MASt3R 0.131/0.098/2.889. Metric-scale depth: MASt3R and CUT3R score **AbsRel 84.9–99.1 with δ&lt;1.03 inlier ratio = 0.000** across all five datasets.

## VGGT 在物体尺度上本来就弱

E3D-Bench（16 个模型、6 任务、11 数据集）原文：

## 但这反而让方向清楚了

你问"具身里用得多的是什么"——查 VGGT 采用率那一路还在跑，但从今天所有调研看，具身圈真正天天在用的是：

```
DINOv2          你说的，基本必备
SigLIP/CLIP     语言对齐
VLM hidden state (z)   WoG/OpenVLA 的动作条件
latent action   LAPA/UniVLA 那一路
压缩未来条件 (O^c)      WoG 这类
```

**前两个是通用视觉表征，后三个是为行动学的表征。**

而你那个实验的方法（无容量线性桥）可以问一个具身圈的真问题：

> **后三个（为行动学的）能不能从前两个（通用的）线性读出来？**

如果能 → 那些"为行动学 latent"没创造新信息，只是选了读法
如果不能 → 找到了通用表征缺的东西

**这个版本绑在具身上，量的是别人天天用的东西，而且不碰 VGGT 的弱项。**

# arXiv 事实核查报告：VGGT / DUSt3R / pi3 在机器人学习中的负面结果

全部 14 篇论文均已下载 abs 页 + 全文 HTML 并 grep 核实。标注 **【已核实】** 表示引文逐字来自全文 HTML。

---

## 第一梯队：真正的负面 / 令人失望结果（最有价值）

### ★★★ 1. arXiv:2605.24642 — 最重量级的负面结果（原候选清单中没有，我从 GWM-VLA 参考文献中挖出）
- **标题**: "Understanding the Impact of Geometric Foundation Models on Vision-Language-Action Models"
- **提交日期**: 2026-05-23 (v1 only) | **Comments**: None | **分类**: cs.CV; cs.RO
- **作者/机构**: Yurou Yang, Muyuan Lin, Roberto Martin-Martin, Martin Labrie, Shreekant Gayaka, Cheng-Hao Kuo, **Luca Carlone** — Amazon Personal Robotics Group / UT Austin / MIT
- 设置: GR00T-N1.5 + VGGT，三种注入架构（Early Fusion / Late Fusion / Spatial Forcing），RoboCasa (600 trials) + LIBERO (500 trials/task) + Unitree G1 真机，**并用 McNemar 检验算 p 值**

**核心负面引文【已核实】**:
&gt; "**Key Takeaway. Task-level finetuning of geometric VLAs combining GR00T-N1.5 and VGGT does not lead to a statistically significant increase in the success rate.**"

&gt; "From a quick glance at the table, the results show that **in average the performance of the geometric VLAs is subpar compared to the GR00T baseline** (e.g., 69.7% for Early Fusion vs. 71.2% for the baseline). However, closer inspection of the p values suggests that the baseline results are just not significantly different from the baseline"

&gt; "In conclusion, **basic finetuning of geometric VLAs does not fundamentally change success rate in simulated benchmarks.**"

RoboCasa 数据（vs GR00T-N1.5 = 71.7 avg）: Early Fusion 69.7 (p=0.399)、Late Fusion 71.0 (p=0.806)、Spatial Forcing 68.3 (p=0.154) — **全部不显著，且两个低于 baseline**。

LIBERO 附录 0.E.1【已核实】:
&gt; "The average success rates in Table A.3 seem to suggest that Late Fusion and Spatial Forcing outperform the baseline, while **Early Fusion lags slightly behind**. However, from a closer inspection of the p values —and consistently with Section 5.2— **the differences between the baseline and the geometric VLAs are not statistically significant and are likely the result of random fluctuations rather than actual performance gain or loss.**"

LIBERO avg: GR00T-N1.5 87.9 / Early Fusion 86.6 (p=0.138) / Late Fusion 90.9 (p=0.561) / Spatial Forcing 91.5 (p=0.295)。

**关键的「何时才有用」条件（对你选题极重要）**:
- 多相机时无收益，**单相机时才显著**:【已核实】"One may conjecture that GR00T might already be able to infer depth information from multiple camera views... the advantage of Early Fusion becomes more pronounced (21.5% vs. 17.2% for the baseline) and statistically significant (p&lt;0.05)"
- 需要大规模 mid-training 才解锁:【已核实】"Early Fusion's performance largely improves and becomes better than baseline (in a statistically significant manner) **after training it on a larger amount of data before finetuning**"
- Late Fusion（注入 action expert）几乎无效:【已核实】"the action expert is relatively 'rigid' and **unable to make good use of additional data sources** (as in the Late Fusion)"
- Spatial Forcing 微调 LLM 反而更差:【已核实】"We also attempted to finetune the LLM in Spatial Forcing, but **obtained worse results**"

### ★★★ 2. arXiv:2605.30671 — WristCompass（腕部/第一视角 VGGT 彻底失败）
- **标题**: "WristCompass: Kinematic Coupling as a Learnable Visual Concept for Ego-Camera Orientation"
- **提交日期**: 2026-05-29 | **Comments**: None | **分类**: cs.CV; cs.RO

**核心负面引文【已核实】**（VGGT 输不过常数预测器）:
&gt; "The obvious approach, inferring orientation from scene geometry, fails when hands occlude the frame: **VGGT, a 1B-parameter scene reconstruction model, scores worse than a constant predictor on the TACO benchmark.**"

&gt; "Scene-based approaches fail where hands occlude the frame: VGGT, a 1B-parameter scene reconstruction model, scores 23.98° median geodesic error on the bimanual manipulation benchmark TACO, worse than a constant predictor (21.22°). **The scene-geometry concept simply does not exist when the scene is occluded.**"

&gt; "VGGT, a 1B-parameter transformer trained for 3D scene reconstruction, **inherits the same failure mode: despite state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks**, it scores 23.98° geodesic error on TACO — worse than a constant rotation (21.22°)."

&gt; "**First, VGGT (23.98°) is worse than the constant predictor (21.22°) — confirming that scene-based approaches fail on close-up manipulation video.**"

&gt; "The methods have complementary failure modes: VGGT wins on discrete manipulation tasks (cut, pick-up, take) where scene structure changes predictably, while WristCompass wins on cyclic tasks (stir)... **On TACO — where scene features are largely occluded by close-up hand manipulation — WristCompass wins by over 10°.**"

⚠️ 重要平衡点：在 Epic Kitchens（胸挂 GoPro，场景更开阔）**VGGT 反而赢**：VGGT 12.83° vs WristCompass 14.32° vs constant 18.54°。论文自己提示"COLMAP ground truth may favor VGGT, which shares its scene-geometry assumptions"。

→ 这正是你要的 **(c) 腕部/eye-in-hand + (d) egocentric 特异性失败**：失败条件是**手部遮挡近距离画面**，而不是 egocentric 本身。

### ★★★ 3. arXiv:2605.10485 — VEGA（原清单没有，我搜出来的）：VGGT 作为 teacher 灾难性崩塌
- **标题**: "VEGA: Visual Encoder Grounding Alignment for Spatially-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models"
- **提交日期**: 2026-05-11 | **Comments**: None | **分类**: cs.RO | 北大 + 北京人形机器人创新中心

**Table 2 消融（Move Playingcard Away，Easy / Hard）**:
| 方法 | Easy | Hard |
|---|---|---|
| w/o teacher | 0.70 | **0.34** |
| **VGGT as teacher** | 0.76 | **0.04** |
| FiT3D (DINOv2-based) as teacher | 0.77 | **0.43** |

**核心负面引文【已核实】**:
&gt; "Replacing the teacher with **VGGT-at-encoder yields a marginal Easy improvement but catastrophically degrades Hard performance (0.04), falling far below even the no-teacher baseline.** We attribute this to an **architectural mismatch: VGGT's intermediate representations encode scene-level geometry optimized for novel view synthesis rather than dense patch-level features compatible with ViT token alignment, and this mismatch destabilizes generalization under domain shift.**"

&gt; "**Instead of relying on VGGT, VEGA utilizes FiT3D, which distills 3D Gaussian Splatting properties into a DINOv2 backbone**, yielding dense geometric representations that perfectly match standard ViT architectures."

&gt; 对现有 VGGT-based 方法（Evo-0 / Spatial Forcing / ROCKET / GLaD）的批评:「**They require exhaustive empirical searches to identify optimal alignment layers, which vary across tasks.**」

→ 这是**唯一一篇直接做「VGGT vs DINOv2 系 encoder」头对头对比、且 VGGT 输到低于不用 teacher 的 baseline** 的论文。你要的 (a) 类证据，最强单点。

### ★★★ 4. arXiv:2510.03104 — Geometry Meets Vision（原清单没有）：visual-geometry 特征普遍输给 visual-only
- **标题**: "Geometry Meets Vision: Revisiting Pretrained Semantics in Distilled Fields"
- **提交日期**: 2025-10-03 | **Comments**: None | **分类**: cs.CV; cs.RO | Princeton (Majumdar 组)

**核心负面引文【已核实】**:
&gt; "Secondly, does geometry-grounding improve semantic object localization? **We observe no significant difference in this task.** Thirdly, does geometry-grounding enable higher-accuracy radiance field inversion? ... **Surprisingly, we find that the pose estimation accuracy decreases with geometry-grounded features.**"

&gt; "**Surprisingly, we observe that visual-geometry semantic features underperform visual-only features, despite their greater spatial content.** Our findings highlight that **visual-only semantic features are more versatile than visual-geometry features, even in spatial tasks like pose estimation.**"

&gt; "Specifically, in the coarse pose estimation phase which significantly relies on semantics, **DINOv2 achieves the lowest rotation and translation errors, while VGGT computes the least accurate pose estimates.** These results suggest that **DINOv2 features might be better suited for coarse pose estimation compared to VGGT features, despite the geometry-grounding procedure.** Consequently, our findings indicate that **existing methods for geometry-grounding may degrade the versatility of semantic features as general-purpose image features**"

&gt; "However, **we observe marginal degradation in performance with geometry-grounded features (VGGT).**"

→ **直接 VGGT vs DINOv2/DINOv3 对比，VGGT 输**，且是 open-vocabulary 机器人 policy 场景（cs.RO 交叉）。

### 1.2 具身世界模型样本（146 篇全文）

DINO 系 **34.2%** / point cloud 26.0% / depth 20.5% / DINOv2 19.2% / **3D-FM 全家 4.8%** / **VGGT 4.1%** / SigLIP 2.1%。

**比例更极端：DINO 系 : 3D-FM = 7.1 : 1。** 注意这里 DINOv2 占比反而比 VLA 高（19.2% vs 12.6%）—— 因为 **DINO-WM 已成为潜空间世界模型的默认底座**。

### 1.3 时间趋势（摘要级，cs.RO）

| 窗口 | VGGT (cs / cs.RO) | DINOv2 (cs / cs.RO) |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-05~08 | 2 / **0** | 68 / 4 |
| 2025-09~12 | 31 / 7 | 95 / 9 |
| 2026-01~04 | 71 / **15** | 100 / 10 |
| 2026-05~09 | 78 / **14** | 204 / **24** |

VGGT 在 2025 下半年快速起量后**已经平台化**（15→14），而 DINOv2 仍在增长。**VGGT 不是在指数爬升的新星，是已经见顶的小众工具。**

### 1.4 代表性论文列表（全部已核实 abs 页）

**"VGGT 作为对齐目标"这条线的奠基作：**
- **Spatial Forcing** `2510.12276`｜2025-10-14 (v2 10-17)｜cs.RO｜Comments 空 — 把 VLA 中间视觉 embedding 对齐到 3D-FM 几何表征，训练加速最多 3.8×。这是后续十几篇的共同祖先。
- **QDepth-VLA** `2510.14836`｜2025-10-16 (v3 2026-06-09)｜cs.CV;cs.RO — 预测 VQ-VAE 量化深度 token 作辅助监督。

**把 VGGT 当编码器用的（少数派）：**
- **VGGT-DP** `2509.18778`｜2025-09-23 (v2 2026-08-25)｜cs.RO — 唯一标题带 VGGT 的操作策略论文，MetaWorld 上超 DP/DP3。
- **Geometric Action Model (GAM)** `2606.17046`｜2026-06-15 (v2 06-22)｜cs.RO;cs.CV;cs.LG｜Project page — GFM 中间层劈开当共享 backbone。
- **GWM-VLA** `2608.07619`｜2026-08-07｜cs.RO — 用 VGGT-Ω 做多视角状态编码。
- **AdaGeoVLN** `2609.18789`｜2026-09-16｜cs.RO — 分层 GFM 特征注入 VLN 策略。

**辅助监督 / 蒸馏（主流用法）：**
`2608.04633` Mind-VLA｜`2608.24714` GaussianWAM｜`2608.25659` GaussianDream++｜`2607.05468` MECo-WAM（冻结 VGGT 做 relational target）｜`2606.14048` WAM4D｜`2606.04436` 3DThinkVLA｜`2606.18375` PAIWorld（Latent 3D-REPA）｜`2507.01099` Geometry-aware 4D VideoGen（**ICLR 2026**）

**pointmap 作输入/表征（绕开 VGGT 本身）：**
- **See like a Robot** `2607.11498`｜2026-07-13｜cs.RO;cs.AI — robot-centric pointmap，改善 π0.5 与 SmolVLA。
- **PointAction** `2606.03943`｜2026-06-02｜cs.RO;cs.CV;cs.LG
- **G³VLA** `2606.24472`｜2026-06-23｜**Submitted to CoRL 2026**
- **Flex-π** `2608.10860`｜2026-08-11 (v3 08-29)｜cs.RO;cs.CV — 关键发现：**冻结的视频生成 VAE 几乎无损地编码 pointmap，完全不需要 VGGT**。

&gt; SLAM / 导航 / 自动驾驶侧另有 19 篇（CoMo3R-SLAM、ScaRF-SLAM (**RA-L 2026**)、Calib3R、DVGT、VLGA 等）。**这是 3D-FM 真正的主战场，但它不是"具身 latent space"。**

## 2. 用在哪个位置（28 篇具身论文人工分类）

| 位置 | 篇数 | 占比 |
|---|---|---|
| **(b) 辅助监督 / 蒸馏对齐**（训练时用，推理时移除） | **12** | **43%** |
| (c) 数据预处理 / pointmap 作表征 | 5 | 18% |
| (d) 评测 / 分析 / 探针 | 4 | 14% |
| **(a) 视觉编码器替代 DINOv2** | **4** | **14%** |
| (a/b 混合、a-partial、纯引用) | 3 | 11% |

**核心结论：VGGT 在具身领域的主流用法是"训练时的一次性教师"，不是编码器。** 43% 的论文明确在推理时把 VGGT 整个拿掉（GaussianWAM 原文："All teacher models, Gaussian components, and auxiliary prediction heads are removed after training"）。**把 VGGT 当 DINOv2 的替代品装进 policy 的只有 4 篇，占 14%。**

## 3. 有人报告 VGGT 在机器人场景失效吗？—— 有，且证据很硬

### 3.1 SpatialBench：你的线索**逐字命中**【已核实】

`2605.27367`｜**SpatialBench: Is Your Spatial Foundation Model an All-Round Player?**｜2026-05-26 (v2 05-29)｜**仅 cs.CV，未交叉列到 cs.RO**｜Comments: Project Page｜19 数据集 / 546 场景 / **41 模型 / 6 范式**

Intro 贡献 (4) 原文：
&gt; "**Egocentric and wrist-view domains remain the dominant OOD failure modes, exposing a field-level gap that cannot be addressed by scaling existing training mixtures alone.**"

正文：
&gt; "performance drops sharply on ego-view and especially wrist-view sequences. **This failure is not caused by a single weak model: the OOD curve averages over the full evaluated method pool, indicating a field-level limitation.** ... **real robot wrist-view data is systematically absent.**"

**硬数字（AbsRel↓, sparse）：**

| 模型 | 7-Scenes 室内 | RLBench wrist | RoboTwin wrist | DROID 真机 wrist |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **VGGT** | 0.068 | **0.296** | **0.369** | 0.111 |
| DUSt3R | 0.075 | **0.830** | **0.728** | 0.301 |
| MASt3R | 0.085 | 0.419 | 0.756 | 0.203 |
| π³ | 0.063 | 0.205 | 0.309 | 0.151 |

**VGGT 在 wrist 视角劣化 4–5 倍，DUSt3R 约 10 倍。**

两条额外的高价值引文：附录 A.1 —— "**none of these methods are trained on wrist-view domains, and we observe significant failure cases under the close-range, high-motion conditions**"（失效归因落到 **近距离 + 高运动** 两个物理因子）；Figure 19 —— "**WorldMirror fails on out-of-distribution scenes such as wrist-view sequences, even with both camera and depth priors provided**"（**即便同时喂入相机+深度先验仍失效** → 不是先验缺失，是表征/训练分布问题）。

另：VGGT / MapAnything / MASt3R / DUSt3R 在 dense regime **全部 OOM（&gt;140G）**。

### 3.2 WristCompass：VGGT **不如常数预测器**【已核实】

`2605.30671`｜2026-05-29｜cs.CV;cs.RO｜Comments 空

&gt; "The obvious approach, inferring orientation from scene geometry, fails when hands occlude the frame: **VGGT, a 1B-parameter scene reconstruction model, scores worse than a constant predictor on the TACO benchmark.**"
&gt; "**assumptions that break on close-up manipulation video where hands occlude most of the frame** ... it scores 23.98° geodesic error on TACO — worse than a constant rotation (21.22°)."

TACO：常数 21.2° / **VGGT-1B 24.0°** / WristCompass-200K **13.8°**。

⚠️ **必须成对引用**：在 Epic Kitchens 上 **VGGT 反而赢**（12.8° vs WristCompass 14.3°），作者自陈 "COLMAP ground truth may favor VGGT"。**精确表述是"手部严重遮挡的近距离双手操作视频上失效"，不是"egocentric 普遍失效"。**

### 3.3 Any3D-VLA：VGGT 注入增益"relatively limited"【已核实】

`2602.00807`｜**ICML 2026**｜2026-01-31 (v2 05-14)｜cs.CV;cs.RO

&gt; "**even in simulation with perfect depth**, directly feeding depth as an additional image channel, or injecting implicit and reconstruction-based spatial priors via models such as VGGT, **yields relatively limited gains.** The potential reason ... they often **lack precise metric alignment and are prone to spatial hallucinations during fine-grained manipulation.**"
&gt; Appendix K: "Spatial foundation models such as VGGT provide strong correspondences and localization cues on the image plane, **but they may not produce representations that are optimal for manipulation.**"

结论：**显式 point-cloud + 2D patch 融合 &gt; VGGT 隐式先验注入**。

### 3.4 ⚠️ 重要纠偏：`2605.24642` 的结论与"VGGT 没用"**相反**

`2605.24642`｜**Understanding the Impact of Geometric Foundation Models on VLA**｜2026-05-23｜cs.CV;cs.RO｜Comments 空｜**MIT SPARK Lab (Luca Carlone) + UT Austin**

这是**唯一一篇严格带 p 值的 VGGT-in-VLA 消融**（GR00T-N1.5 + VGGT，三种注入架构）：

- **线性探针确认 geometric gap 存在**（NYU Depth，RMSE↓/δ₁↑）：GR00T vision encoder **0.92/0.51** → GR00T VLM **0.73/0.63** → **VGGT 0.41/0.89**。原文："**the depth information is already lost after the vision encoder.**"
- **但朴素 finetune 下无统计显著增益**：RoboCasa baseline 71.7 / Early Fusion 69.7 (p=0.399) / Late 71.0 (p=0.806) / Spatial Forcing 68.3 (p=0.154)。原文 takeaway："**does not lead to a statistically significant increase in the success rate.**"
- **三个条件下确实有用**：mid-training（75.2 vs 71.7）；**单相机设置 21.5% vs 17.2%，p=0.030 显著**；真机 Unitree G1 的 Approach 阶段 **84.4% vs 57.8%, p&lt;0.001**。
- 且原文称 VGGT 在 RoboCasa 上 "**depth errors are relatively small, confirming the outstanding generalization capabilities of VGGT**"；深度误差与成功率 Spearman ρ 仅 **−0.202**。
- **全文没有 wrist 专项分析**（"wrist" 仅 5 次，都是设置描述）。

&gt; **与 SpatialBench 的张力及化解**：RoboCasa 是仿真、纹理简单、相机运动温和；SpatialBench 的失效归因是 **close-range + high-motion（真机 DROID）**。**建议并置引用，把这个张力本身当研究缺口写。**

**单相机显著、多相机不显著**这个发现尤其重要：暗示**多相机设置下策略已能从多视几何自行获得深度，GFM 的边际价值被稀释**。

### 3.5 其他失效/成本批评
- `2606.22987` **Can Single-View Mesh Reconstruction Generalize to Robot Camera Rotation?**｜2026-06-22 — 真机 Franka wrist 序列上 "camera rotations induce MDE distortion, layout drift, and collision penetration"。（⚠️ 测的是 SAM3D 类管线，非 VGGT 本体）
- `2605.14950` **Evo-Depth**｜2026-05-14 — "these methods often introduce large-scale geometry foundation models, such as VGGT. This **increases model size and raises training and deployment costs, making them less suitable for real-time robotic deployment.**"
- `2506.01933` **E3D-Bench**｜2025-06-02 (v3 07-10) — "**MASt3R frequently fails across a variety of settings**"；"**Metric-scale depth estimation remains a key challenge for GFMs**"。⚠️ 但它把 egocentric 列为泛化良好，**且完全没有 wrist-view 轴** —— 反衬 SpatialBench 的增量。

**【未能证实】** 没有任何论文在摘要层字面说"我们试过 VGGT 但没用"。最接近的就是上面 3.2/3.3/3.4 三篇。**也没有 VGGT vs DINOv2 作为 policy encoder 的直接负面消融** —— `"VGGT DINOv2 policy"` 全字段检索仅 1 条（VO-DP `2510.15530`，且是正面融合）。**这是真实的文献空白。**

## 4. 具身领域真正常用的 3D 表征

**优先级排序（基于 199 + 146 篇全文频次）：**

1. **深度图 / RGB-D（23.1% VLA / 20.5% WM）** — 最常用。硬件直出，无需推理开销。
2. **点云 + PointNet / DP3（15.1% / 26.0%）** — 显式 3D 的事实标准。DP3 在 VLA 样本中被提及 **14/199 (7.0%)**，PointNet 仅 3 篇（多数用 DP3 封装）。Any3D-VLA (ICML 2026) 实测**点云+2D patch 融合 &gt; VGGT 隐式注入**。
3. **3D Gaussian / 体素（gaussian splatting + manipulation 摘要级 25 篇 cs.RO；voxel 8.0%）** — 世界模型侧增长快。
4. **pointmap（不必经由 VGGT）** — Flex-π 证明**冻结视频 VAE 几乎无损编码 pointmap**，这是对 VGGT 最直接的替代性打击。
5. **VGGT / 3D-FM（4.5% / 4.1%，真实使用 ~2.5-3%）** — 垫底，且主要以"训练时教师"形式存在。

**最关键的一个数字：68.8%（137/199）的 VLA 论文全文完全不提任何显式 3D（点云/体素/深度/3D-FM/Depth Anything）。** 主流方案就是**不用显式 3D**，直接 2D VLM backbone + action head。

**作为对照，真正的"标配"是：OpenVLA 被提及 141/199 (70.9%)、GR00T 89/199 (44.7%)、π0 16/199 (8.0%)。**

---

## 5. 反向问题：DINOv2 里已经含有 3D 信息吗？

### 5.1 你记的那篇存在，ID 已核实

**Probing the 3D Awareness of Visual Foundation Models**｜`2404.08636`｜2024-04-12｜**Accepted to CVPR 2024**｜El Banani, Raj, Maninis, Kar, Li, Rubinstein, Sun, Guibas, Johnson, Jampani

**探测对象**（26 checkpoint / 10 目标）：DeiT III、MAE、iBOT、DINO、**DINOv2**、CLIP、SigLIP、StableDiffusion、SAM、MiDaS。冻结特征 + probe，不 fine-tune。

**两项能力**：① 单视表面重建（depth + normals）② 多视一致性（dense correspondence，zero-shot）

**结论（原文）：**
- ✅ "recent self-supervised models such as **DINOv2 learn representations that encode depth and surface normals**, with StableDiffusion being a close second"
- ❌ VLM 是显著例外："**with vision-language models being the notable exception**"（CLIP/SigLIP 很差）
- ❌ **失效点正是多视一致性**："models are learning representations that are **view-consistent, not 3D consistent**"；"consistency across images is **semantic in nature**"；大 baseline 下 "absolute performances for all models are very low"
- ⚠️ 对你做 utility 实验有用的细节：模型层面 depth/normal 高度相关，但 **DINOv2 误差在图像级相关仅 0.37、像素级仅 0.13**

**一句话：DINOv2 有的是 2.5D（单视可读出深度/法向），缺的是跨视几何一致性。**

### 5.2 后续确认与修复路径（全部已核实）

| 论文 | ID | Venue | 要点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Feat2GS** | `2412.09606` | **Journal-ref: CVPR 2025** | **最对口**：直接对比 DINOv2 vs DUSt3R/MASt3R。Geometry 模式 RADIO&gt;MASt3R&gt;DUSt3R。**关键归因："One crucial factor is 3D data"** —— DUSt3R vs MiDaS 同为 ViT-L/16、规模可比（3M vs 2M），但 MiDaS 差得多 → "**pointmap representation is more reasonable than depth**"。复现了 Probe3D 的多视不一致结论 |
| Lexicon3D | `2409.03757` | **NeurIPS 2024** | 7 encoder × 4 任务，**DINOv2 综合最强** |
| A General Protocol to Probe LVMs for 3D Physical Understanding | `2310.06836` | — | 早于 Probe3D（Zisserman 组）。SD 与 DINOv2 对 geometry/support/shadow/depth 都好，**occlusion 与 material 差** |
| Multiview Equivariance Improves 3D Correspondence | `2411.19458` | **ICLR 2025** | **直接修复 Probe3D 的失效点**："finetuning on a single object for one iteration results in substantial gains" |
| Improving 2D Feature Representations by 3D-Aware Fine-Tuning | `2407.20229` | **ECCV 2024** | lift 到 3DGS 再重渲染微调，linear probing 下 seg + depth 双升 |
| Last-Layer-Centric Feature Recombination (DINOv3) | `2604.26454` | — | **3D 信息层间分布非均匀，越深层 depth predictability 越强** |
| From Edges to Depth | `2604.23452` | — | 纯分类 ViT-B/16，**linear probe 在 NYU 解码 depth 达 MAE 0.0875（layer 8 峰值）**；因果干预：消融该单一方向使 depth 解码退化 **165%**，消融任意其他方向 &lt;1% |
| SeeSE3 | `2607.14228` | — | 明确替代 Probe3D 范式，转向 **SE(3)** 群结构；自监督模型存在与三维欧氏空间高度相关的潜子空间 |
| DINOcular | `2608.27226` | — | 反向：RGB-D 注入几何先验改善 3D awareness |
| **CALIPER** | `2609.08250` | — | ⚠️ **对 probing 方法论的重要警告**：干净固定相机下 8 种表征（V-JEPA 2 到随机 ViT 到 raw pixels）全落在 simulator 上界 **0.02 R²** 内；重采样相机/光照/杂乱后散布到 **0.50 R²**。"**Linear probes track none of this**" |

### 5.3 DINOv2 vs VGGT 特征的直接对照
- **RoMa-Ω** `2609.09507`｜2026-09-08 — **唯一真正把 DINO backbone 换成 VGGT-Ω 并拿到 SOTA 的实证**（WxBS +8.1 mAA）。但同时发现"前馈重建模型 **zero-shot 匹配很差**，尤其后面的层"。
- `2512.11508`｜On Geometric Understanding and Learned Priors in Feed-forward 3D Models（Brox, Rupprecht）— **epipolar geometry 在 DUSt3R/VGGT/DA3 中间层涌现**，与 attention head 存在因果联系。
- `2607.09503`｜What VGGT Knows About Overlap — VGGT 呈现类 LLM 层级结构：早层建 3D-aware 表征、晚层做 co-visibility 推理，**L17 是一贯 negative anchor**。

**【未能证实】** 没有专门论证"DINOv2 特征可**线性**解码为 **metric depth / point map**"的论文。相关检索全零。**这是空白。**
**【未能证实】** 没有"把 DINOv2 蒸馏进 VGGT"的工作。反向有（`2509.15880` eVGGT 快 9× 小 5×、`2608.23850` DDMS、`2511.22429` Fin3R **NeurIPS 2025**）。

## 6. 跨编码器可互译性

### 6.1 Platonic Representation Hypothesis【已核实】

`2405.07987`｜2024-05-13 (v5 07-25)｜Huh, Cheung, Wang, Isola (MIT)｜cs.LG;cs.AI;cs.CV;cs.NE

⚠️ **两个引用陷阱**：(1) **arXiv Comments 字段不含 venue**；venue 是 **ICML 2024 Position Paper track (Oral)**，PMLR 235:20617–20642 —— 需外部确认。(2) **正式题名带 "Position:" 前缀**，arXiv 版没有。

**度量**：mutual nearest-neighbor alignment（k-NN 集合交集 / k）。**三条证据**：视觉内部 alignment 随 VTAB 能力上升；跨模态经 WIT caption 桥接，语言能力越强与视觉 alignment 越高；alignment 预测 Hellaswag / GSM8K。

**作者自陈局限（建议直接引用）**：
&gt; alignment 绝对值只到 **~0.16**（理论上限 1）—— "Is a score of 0.16 indicative of strong alignment ... or does it signify poor alignment? **We leave this as an open question.**"
&gt; **明确点出机器人是例外**："in robotics there is **not yet a standardized approach to representing world states** in the same way as there is for representing images and text."

### 6.2 2025-2026 对 PRH 的协调攻击【全部已核实】

| 论文 | ID | Venue | 反驳 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Revisiting the PRH: An Aristotelian View** | `2602.14486` | **ICML 2026 camera-ready** | **最强方法论反驳**：相似度度量被 network scale 混淆，加深/加宽会系统性抬高分数。permutation-based null-calibration 后**全局谱度量的"收敛"基本消失**，只有 local neighborhood similarity 保留 |
| **Back into Plato's Cave** | `2604.18572` | — (含 Efros) | alignment 在 **~1K 样本**上测得，**扩到百万样本后显著退化**。"Models trained on different modalities may learn equally rich representations of the world, **just not the same one**" |
| Objective drives consistency | `2411.05561` | — (含 Kornblith) | **目标函数是关键**，自监督视觉跨数据集泛化最好 |
| Convergence Without Understanding | `2605.23315` | — | 决策前 CKA 0.875 → 决策后 0.274；共享信息可解码 66% 但因果影响仅 1.5-5.5% |
| Representation Alignment Rests on Linear Structure | `2605.28870` | — (Bresler, Polyanskiy) | PRH 源于 Linear Representation Hypothesis；SAE 稀疏特征跨模态对齐强于 dense |
| Proof of a perfect PRH | `2507.01098` | "A note" (Ziyin, Chuang) | EDLN 中证明 Perfectly Platonic，**同时列出至少六种打破 PRH 的方式** |

### 6.3 Relative representations / model stitching 谱系【全部已核实】

- **Relative representations enable zero-shot latent space communication**｜`2209.15430`｜**ICLR 2023 notable top 5%**
- **Understanding image representations by measuring equivariance and equivalence**（Lenc &amp; Vedaldi）｜`1411.5908`｜⚠️ **Comments 空，CVPR 2015 无法从 arXiv 证实**
- **Revisiting Model Stitching to Compare Neural Representations**（Bansal, Nakkiran, Barak）｜`2106.07682`｜2021-06-14｜⚠️ **Comments 与 Journal-ref 均空，你猜的 NeurIPS 2021 从 arXiv 无法证实**
- **Similarity and Matching of Neural Network Representations**（Csiszárik et al.）｜`2110.14633`｜✅ Comments 写明 **NeurIPS 2021**
- **Revisiting Model Stitching In the Foundation Model Era**｜`2603.12433`｜**Accepted by CVPR 2026** — **线程 B 最有用的一篇**：异质 VFM（CLIP/DINOv2/SigLIP 2）能否 stitch？① **stitch layer 训练方式是决定性的**，传统做法浅 stitch point 必败；② 改用 **target 模型 penultimate layer 的 feature-matching loss** 就可靠可缝；③ 深 stitch point 下缝合模型**可超越任一组成模型**
- **vec2vec / Harnessing the Universal Geometry of Embeddings**｜`2505.12540`｜首个无配对数据的 embedding 跨空间翻译
- **mini-vec2vec**｜`2510.02348`｜**学到的映射就是一个线性变换**，效率高数个数量级
- ⚠️ **How Far Do Simple Transformations Translate Across Text Embedding Models?**｜`2608.05980`｜**重要负面**："heterogeneous embedding spaces are **not universally related by simple mappings** as often suggested"
- **Text-To-Concept (and Back)**｜`2305.06386`｜**ICML 2023**｜早期关键观察："the mapping between an image's representation in one model to its representation in another **can be learned surprisingly well with just a linear layer, even across diverse models**"

### 6.4 ★ 机器人/具身领域的 stitching —— 有，但非常薄（这是你的机会）

**最重要的一篇（跨 Q5/Q6 的桥接）：**

**Platonic Representation Hypothesis on World Models**｜`2608.23720`｜2026-08-24 (v2 08-26)｜cs.CV｜18pp

在 **DINO-WM**（`2411.04983`，Zhou/Pan/LeCun/Pinto）上**变换 visual encoder（DINOv2 / SigLIP / MAE / ResNet）制造异质世界模型**，提出 Predictive Consistency Assumption，然后**做 model stitching**：劈开 predictor stack，只训轻量 MLP adapter，其余全冻，用 CEM planner（horizon=5，自回归 rollout）测 Stitched Success Rate。

**Table 2 实测（k=3）：**

| 组合 | SSR PointMaze | SSR Wall |
|---|---|---|
| DINO(1-3) + SigLIP(4-6) | **0.90** | **0.62** |
| DINO(1-3) + MAE(4-6) | 0.84 | 0.42 |
| SigLIP(1-3) + DINO(4-6) | 0.76 | 0.64 |
| SigLIP(1-3) + MAE(4-6) | 0.88 | 0.50 |
| **MAE(1-3) + DINO(4-6)** | 0.74 | **0.02** |
| **MAE(1-3) + SigLIP(4-6)** | 0.72 | **0.00** |

**结论**：强规划器之间近对称可缝（RS≥0.7）；**"transferable Platonic core" 集中在 early-to-mid predictor layers**；但 **MAE 作前端在 Wall 上彻底崩溃（0.02/0.00）** —— "**a lightweight MLP can align feature spaces but cannot supply missing planning-relevant transition factors**"。

**其他机器人 stitching 工作（全部已核实）：**
- **Perception Stitching: Zero-Shot Perception Encoder Transfer for Visuomotor Robot Policies**｜`2406.19971`｜**Journal-ref: TMLR 11/2024**｜真机 manipulation 上 **baseline 全部失败，本方法 zero-shot 成功**
- **Policy Stitching**｜`2309.13753`｜**CoRL 2023**
- ★ **Encoder Winners Do Not Reliably Transfer Across VLA Backbone Scale: A Frozen-Backbone Grafting Diagnostic**｜`2606.14153`｜2026-06-12｜**最对口你的子问题**：把 VLA 的 vision tower 换成候选 encoder，只训单个线性 projector。**结论：encoder 优劣排序依赖 backbone** —— SigLIP 在 SmolVLA 上最好；**在 π0.5 上 DINOv2-small 领先 spatial suite**。自陈 grafting wrapper 非中性且跨 backbone 符号相反
- **A Stitch in Time Saves Nine**｜`2606.21509`｜T-ITS under review｜驾驶域：conv stitching 保住 **&gt;91%** 跨域 driving score，适配时间 **22.18h → 0.91h**

### ASSISTANT — 2026-09-18 15:27

你问得准。我的答案是：**WoG 不再是好媒介，但你在 WoG 上积累的东西是。**

## 为什么 WoG 不适合做这件事

那个 stitching 实验的核心是**换编码器、比互译性**。而 WoG 的结构限制了这个：

- `O^c` 是 16×32 = 512 维，**它已经是压缩过的产物**，不是编码器输出
- 它的 DINOv2 是 frozen 的，换掉就等于换掉整个 FutureEnc，要重训 Stage-I
- 部署时 `O^c` 根本不存在

**最关键的一条**：WoG 只有一个编码器。而 stitching 需要**多个编码器互换**才有实验设计。

## 但 DINO-WM 正好合适

那篇 2026-08 的论文用的就是它，而且它的结构天然支持这件事：

```
DINO-WM:  编码器（可换） → predictor（可劈开）→ planner
                ↑ 这里换 DINOv2/SigLIP/MAE
                       ↑ 这里插 MLP 做 stitching
```

**而且 DINO-WM 是个小模型，单卡能训。**

## 你在 WoG 上积累的东西不浪费

| 资产 | 还能用吗 |
|---|---|
干预框架（固定噪声、只换条件、测输出变化） | ✅ 直接搬 |
配对噪声的方法学纪律 | ✅ 核心 |
`d_eff` / TwoNN + 三对照 | ✅ 就是量互译性的工具 |
"probe 不可靠" 的教训 | ✅ 正是无容量桥要绕开的 |
OXE 235G 数据 | ✅ 真实操作数据，正是缺口 |
WoG 两个 checkpoint | ⚠️ 变成一个**对照点**，不是主角 |

**WoG 从"研究对象"降级成"多个被测对象之一"。** 这反而更好——`O^c` 是一个"为行动学的压缩条件"，正好可以放进你的互译性矩阵里，跟 DINOv2/SigLIP 这些通用表征比。

## 所以新的形态是

> 不是"在 WoG 上做创新"，而是"**用 WoG 提供一个别人没有的测试点**"。

那篇 2026-08 的论文只测了通用编码器（DINOv2/SigLIP/MAE）。**而你能加上"为行动学的表征"这一类**——`O^c`、`z`、latent action。

**这正是我之前说的那个矩阵**：通用表征 vs 为行动学的表征，谁能读懂谁。

---

**我想确认一件事再往下**：你愿意把主战场从 WoG 换到 DINO-WM 吗？

换的代价是要重新搭一套环境（但 DINO-WM 小、单卡能训、代码公开）。收益是你能真正做 stitching 实验，而不是被 WoG 的单编码器结构卡住。
